text:
Functional Requirement
1.1 Complaint Registration Function
Function ID: FR-01
Description: Citizens can register a new complaint with the system. The system validates the input data and verified citizen identity, generates a unique complaint ID, assigns the complaint to eligible criminal police personnel when possible, controls the complaint lifecycle state, and provides a clear registration outcome to the citizen.
Input: Complaint type, date, location, description of incident, verified citizen identity, citizen credentials.
Output: A new complaint record stored in the system with a complaint ID, complaint lifecycle state outcome, resubmission allowed outcome if registration fails, and a confirmation or rejection message sent to the citizen.
1.2 View Complaint Details Function
Function ID: FR-02
Description: Authorized actors can view the details of a registered complaint. The system validates the complaint ID, actor credentials, role permissions, and requested data scope before displaying complaint details. The system logs the viewing action and displays related court case, investigation, and linked criminal information summaries when available and authorized.
Input: Valid complaint ID, actor credentials, actor role, requested data scope, security policy validation.
Output: Complaint details displayed to the user, including permitted type, date, location, description, related investigation information, related court case information, and linked criminal information summary when authorized.
1.3 Update Investigation Status Function
Function ID: FR-03
Description: Criminal Police Personnel or Security Administrators can update the status of an investigation. The system validates the complaint or investigation identifier, verifies that the requested status transition is allowed, logs the action, updates linked court case status when applicable, and sends notifications only when the transition is permitted.
Input: Valid complaint ID or investigation ID, current investigation status, requested investigation status, actor credentials, authorized role, optional notes or evidence, related court case ID if applicable.
Output: Updated investigation status stored in the system, transition allowed response, notification dispatch eligibility, related court case status synchronization result if applicable, and action log entry.
1.4 Delete Investigation Record Function
Function ID: FR-04
Description: Security Administrators or authorized Criminal Police Personnel can delete an existing investigation record only when deletion authorization, confirmation, eligibility, current investigation status, and active court case linkage constraints are satisfied. The system logs the deletion decision, performs recovery if deletion fails or partially succeeds, and notifies stakeholders when deletion affects linked court case matters.
Input: Valid investigation ID or complaint ID, deletion confirmation, actor credentials, requester role, current investigation status, active court case linkage state, deletion request details.
Output: Deletion permitted or denied outcome, deletion denied reason if applicable, linked active court case handling outcome, investigation record deletion result, rollback or recovery confirmation if needed, notification delivery record when applicable, and audit log entry.
1.5 Register Criminal Information Function
Function ID: FR-05
Description: Criminal Police Personnel can register new criminal information based on a complaint or investigation when authorized for the targeted case scope. The system validates the data, generates a criminal information ID and criminal ID, links the record to the complaint, investigation, and court case if available, supports deferred linkage when court case linkage is absent, and rolls back operation-created records and linkages if registration fails.
Input: Valid complaint ID, investigation ID if applicable, court case ID if applicable, suspect details, evidence, witness statements, requester role, requester assignment scope, actor credentials.
Output: A new criminal information record stored in the system, criminal information ID, criminal ID, linkage status with complaint/investigation/court case, deferred linkage requirement indicator when applicable, investigation progress update if triggered, and action log entry.
1.6 View Criminal Profile Function
Function ID: FR-06
Description: Authorized actors can view the profile of a registered criminal. The system validates the criminal ID or search criteria, actor credentials, role permissions, and requester assignment scope before displaying criminal profile information. The system ensures privacy, restricts unauthorized data, and provides related complaints, investigations, court cases, and latest criminal information when authorized.
Input: Valid criminal ID, criminal information ID or search criteria, actor credentials, requester role, requester assignment scope, authorization rules.
Output: Criminal profile information displayed within the permitted scope, including personal details, latest criminal information, criminal history when available, related complaint information, investigation information, and court case information.
1.7 Modify Police Personnel Details Function
Function ID: FR-07
Description: Security Administrators or authorized Criminal Police Personnel can modify the details of registered police personnel. The system validates the personnel ID and updated data, checks whether changes affect existing assignments, and logs the change.
Input: Valid personnel ID, updated details such as contact information, role, status, department, and actor credentials.
Output: Updated personnel record stored in the system, access to the updated information for authorized users, and audit log entry.
1.8 Assign Case to Police Personnel Function
Function ID: FR-08
Description: Security Administrators can assign a complaint, investigation, or court case to eligible criminal police personnel. The system validates case identifiers, personnel ID, personnel availability, role criteria, requester assignment scope, and actor authorization. If the selected personnel is unavailable or ineligible, the system attempts alternative eligible personnel selection. If no eligible personnel exists, the case enters a defined unassigned state and escalation is required. Assignment failures are rolled back to preserve consistency.
Input: Valid complaint ID, investigation ID or court case ID, case ID, selected personnel ID, personnel availability state, required role criteria, requester assignment scope, actor credentials.
Output: Assignment outcome mapping, assigned personnel ID when successful, alternative personnel selection result when applicable, assignment rejection reason when ineligible, unassigned case outcome when none available, reassignment escalation requirement, rollback outcome on failure, and assignment log entry.
1.9 Remove Court Case Function
Function ID: FR-09
Description: Security Administrators or authorized Criminal Police Personnel can remove a court case record. The system checks authorization, deletion confirmation, active legal processes, and related complaint or investigation linkages before removal.
Input: Valid court case ID, confirmation of removal, actor credentials, active legal process state.
Output: Court case deletion result, deletion denied reason if applicable, related complaint or investigation records updated if necessary, and audit log entry.
1.10 Update Court Case Information Function
Function ID: FR-10
Description: Security Administrators or Criminal Police Personnel can update the information of an existing court case. The system validates the court case ID, actor authorization, and updated information, logs the action, and updates linked complaint or investigation records if applicable. If linked status synchronization fails, the system performs consistency handling or rollback.
Input: Valid court case ID, updated information such as case status and judgment details, actor credentials, authorization, security policy validation.
Output: Updated court case record stored in the system, judgment details stored when applicable, related complaint or investigation records updated if linked, rollback outcome if needed, and audit log entry.
1.11 Search for Cases Function
Function ID: FR-11
Description: Authorized actors can search for cases using various criteria. The system validates credentials, applies access control rules, retrieves relevant case records, logs the search action, and allows authorized users to open selected court case or complaint details.
Input: Search criteria such as case ID, complaint ID, court case ID, date range, crime type, actor credentials, requested data scope.
Output: List of relevant case records displayed within the permitted scope, including status, linked complaint, court information, available detail view entry, and search log entry.
1.12 Search for Criminals Function
Function ID: FR-12
Description: Authorized actors can search for criminal records using identifiers or search criteria. The system validates actor credentials and authorization scope, displays permitted results, logs the search action, and provides refinement suggestions when search fails without exposing unauthorized profile data.
Input: Search criteria such as name, criminal ID, crime type, location, actor credentials, authorization scope.
Output: List of relevant criminal records displayed within the permitted scope, including personal information where authorized, criminal history, associated case details, or search failure response with refinement suggestion.
1.13 Submit Feedback Function
Function ID: FR-13
Description: Citizens can submit feedback regarding a complaint, investigation, or court case. The system validates feedback input, verifies citizen identity and authorization for the related case context, generates a feedback ID, links feedback to the correct case context, logs the submission, and sends a confirmation message.
Input: Feedback type, description, suggestions, optional related complaint ID, investigation ID, court case ID, verified citizen identity, citizen credentials.
Output: A new feedback record stored in the system with feedback ID, case-linked feedback context, submission permission decision, and confirmation or rejection message sent to the citizen.
1.14 Citizen Views Case Updates Function
Function ID: FR-14
Description: Citizens can view the latest updates on their own complaint or court case. The system checks citizen credentials, verifies that the citizen is authorized for the requested complaint or court case, retrieves the latest case details, and logs the viewing action.
Input: Valid complaint ID or court case ID, citizen credentials, verified citizen identity.
Output: Latest case status, investigation progress, related court case information, citizen notification information where applicable, and viewing action log entry.
1.15 Assign Role to User Function
Function ID: FR-15
Description: Security Administrators can assign a role to a user account. The system validates the user ID, role ID or role name, administrator authorization, and role configuration before updating access permissions and logging the assignment.
Input: Valid user ID, role ID or role name, administrator credentials.
Output: Role assigned to the user, updated access permissions, effective permission result, and audit log entry.
1.16 Modify System Configuration Function
Function ID: FR-16
Description: Security Administrators can modify system configurations such as access levels, notification settings, security rules, and role permissions. The system validates configuration parameters, applies the changes, and logs the change.
Input: Valid configuration parameters such as access control rules, notification settings, security rules, role permissions, and administrator credentials.
Output: Updated system configuration stored in the database, changes applied to user permissions and system behavior, and audit log entry.
1.17 Delete Configuration Function
Function ID: FR-17
Description: Security Administrators can delete a system configuration. The system checks administrator authorization, validates the configuration ID, verifies the impact on roles and permissions, and logs the deletion.
Input: Valid configuration ID, confirmation of deletion, administrator credentials.
Output: Configuration deletion result, associated role or permission configuration updates if necessary, deletion denied reason if applicable, and audit log entry.
1.18 Enforce Security Policies Function
Function ID: FR-18
Description: Security Administrators can enforce or modify security policies. The system validates the policy, applies the changes, updates role configuration where applicable, and logs the action.
Input: Policy name, description, enforcement date, role ID if applicable, administrator credentials.
Output: Updated or enforced security policies stored in the system, changes reflected in role configuration and access control, and audit log entry.
1.19 Manage Administrator Permissions Function
Function ID: FR-19
Description: Security Administrators can manage the permissions of other administrator accounts only when authorized to perform the requested administrative action. The system validates the administrator account, requested action, and role configuration before applying permission changes.
Input: Valid administrator ID, updated role permissions, administrator account, requested administrative action, role configuration.
Output: Updated administrator permissions stored in the system, authorization decision, denied action reason if applicable, and audit log entry.
1.20 Manage Case Update Function
Function ID: FR-20
Description: Criminal Police Personnel or Security Administrators can manage case updates by creating, editing, or deleting case update records. The system validates case identifiers, actor authorization, update details, and related linkages, logs the action, and updates court case search or related records when applicable.
Input: Valid case ID, complaint ID or investigation ID, update details such as status, description and date, actor credentials.
Output: Updated case record stored in the database, related court case information updated if linked, failure record if update fails, consistency result, and audit log entry.
1.21 Manage Feedback Record Function
Function ID: FR-21
Description: Security Administrators or Criminal Police Personnel can manage feedback records by viewing, updating, resolving, or linking feedback to case context. The system validates the feedback ID, actor authorization, action type, and related case context before updating the feedback record.
Input: Valid feedback ID, action to be performed such as view, update status or add resolution notes, complaint ID, investigation ID or court case ID if applicable, actor credentials.
Output: Feedback record updated in the database, associated complaint or court case records updated if necessary, citizen notification result if applicable, and audit log entry.
1.22 Manage Assignment Log Function
Function ID: FR-22
Description: Security Administrators or Criminal Police Personnel can manage assignment logs by viewing, updating, or deleting logs where permitted. The system validates the assignment log ID or search criteria, actor credentials, and authorization scope, while preserving auditability of assignment history.
Input: Valid assignment log ID or search criteria such as case ID, personnel ID and date, actor credentials.
Output: Assignment log view, update or deletion result, related records updated if applicable, and audit log entry.
1.23 Delete Complaint Function
Function ID: FR-23
Description: Security Administrators or authorized Criminal Police Personnel can delete a complaint record. The system validates complaint ID, actor authorization, deletion confirmation, active investigation state, active court case state, and criminal record references before deletion.
Input: Valid complaint ID, confirmation of deletion, actor credentials, active investigation state, active court case linkage state.
Output: Complaint deletion result, deletion denied reason if applicable, related court cases, investigations and criminal references updated or preserved as required, and audit log entry.
1.24 Create Investigation Function
Function ID: FR-24
Description: Criminal Police Personnel or Security Administrators can create an investigation record for a valid complaint. The system validates the complaint, actor authorization, assigned personnel eligibility, criminal ID linkage where applicable, and creates the investigation record.
Input: Valid complaint ID, assigned personnel ID, initial investigation status, actor credentials, criminal ID if applicable.
Output: New investigation record stored in the database, investigation ID, complaint and court case updated if applicable, ownership assignment result, and audit log entry.
1.25 View Investigation Function
Function ID: FR-25
Description: Criminal Police Personnel or Security Administrators can view the details of an ongoing investigation. The system validates the investigation ID, actor credentials, and authorization scope, logs the action, and displays related complaint, court case, current status, assigned personnel, and associated criminal history when authorized.
Input: Valid investigation ID, actor credentials, authorization scope, criminal ID if criminal history is requested.
Output: Investigation details displayed, including complaint ID, personnel assigned, current investigation status, related court case information, associated criminal history when authorized, and viewing action log entry.
1.26 Update Criminal Profile Function
Function ID: FR-26
Description: Criminal Police Personnel or Security Administrators can update a criminal profile. The system validates the criminal ID, actor authorization, updated information, and related case references before storing the update and logging the action.
Input: Valid criminal ID, updated information such as personal details, criminal history and investigation findings, actor credentials.
Output: Updated criminal profile stored in the database, related complaint or court case records updated if necessary, and audit log entry.
1.27 Delete Criminal Record Function
Function ID: FR-27
Description: Security Administrators or authorized Criminal Police Personnel can delete a criminal record. The system validates the criminal ID, actor authorization, deletion confirmation, and active court case or investigation constraints before deletion.
Input: Valid criminal ID, confirmation of deletion, actor credentials, active court case or investigation state.
Output: Criminal record deletion result, deletion denied reason if applicable, related records updated or invalidated if necessary, and audit log entry.
1.28 Create Police Personnel Function
Function ID: FR-28
Description: Security Administrators can create a new police personnel record. The system validates personnel details, role ID, department information, and administrator authorization, assigns the role, and logs the creation.
Input: Personnel details such as name, contact information, role, department, valid role ID, administrator credentials.
Output: New police personnel record stored in the database with assigned role, personnel status initialized for assignment eligibility checks, and audit log entry.
1.29 Delete Police Personnel Function
Function ID: FR-29
Description: Security Administrators can delete a police personnel record. The system validates the personnel ID, administrator authorization, deletion confirmation, and active assignment state before deletion.
Input: Valid personnel ID, confirmation of deletion, administrator credentials, active assignment state.
Output: Personnel deletion result, deletion denied reason if active assignments exist, related records updated or invalidated if necessary, and audit log entry.
1.30 Create Court Case Function
Function ID: FR-30
Description: Security Administrators or Criminal Police Personnel can create a new court case linked to an existing complaint or investigation. The system validates the complaint or investigation ID, actor authorization, and court case details before storing and linking the record.
Input: Valid complaint ID or investigation ID, court case details such as case type, filing date and legal status, actor credentials.
Output: New court case record stored in the database, court case ID, linked complaint and investigation references, and audit log entry.
1.31 View Court Case Function
Function ID: FR-31
Description: Security Administrators or Criminal Police Personnel can view court case details. The system validates the court case ID, actor credentials, and authorization scope, retrieves the data, logs the viewing action, and displays related complaint, investigation, and judgment details where authorized.
Input: Valid court case ID, actor credentials, authorization scope.
Output: Court case details displayed, including type, filing date, legal status, judgment details when authorized, related complaint or investigation information, and viewing action log entry.
1.32 Delete Role Function
Function ID: FR-32
Description: Security Administrators can delete a role configuration. The system validates the role ID, administrator authorization, deletion confirmation, and whether the role is currently in use before deletion.
Input: Valid role ID, confirmation of deletion, administrator credentials.
Output: Role deletion result, deletion denied reason if the role is in use, related user assignments invalidated or migrated if necessary, and audit log entry.
1.33 Complaint Registration Failure Recovery
Input: Complaint registration attempt, citizen identity, complaint input data, submission attempt outcome, actor role.
Output: Complaint registration result status, unresolved registration record state, complaint lifecycle state outcome, resubmission allowed outcome, citizen confirmation or failure notice.
Description: Ensure citizens receive consistent registration outcomes and prevent incomplete complaint registration from causing incorrect downstream records. Each complaint submission attempt shall result in a single deterministic lifecycle state and a clear resubmission allowance outcome.
1.34 Notify Citizen on Complaint Registration Outcome
Input: Verified citizen identity, citizen credentials, complaint submission result, citizen contact configuration.
Output: Notification recipient determined, confirmation message for successful registration, rejection reason message for failed validation, notification delivery record.
Description: Provide citizens with timely and clear outcomes of complaint registration submissions and bind complaint outcome notifications to the verified citizen identity.
1.35 Authorization Outcome When Identity Verification Fails
Input: Unverified citizen identity, complaint registration failure condition, actor request intent.
Output: Authorization denied outcome, authorization denial reason, identity verification resubmission instruction reference.
Description: When identity verification fails, deny complaint registration or sensitive information access, return a clear denial reason, and provide instructions for resubmitting identity verification.
1.36 Restrict Citizen Identity Disclosure to Authorized Use
Input: Citizen identity, personal information, actor credentials, actor role, access permissions, request context.
Output: Citizen identity disclosure permitted or restricted, authorized personal information visibility outcome.
Description: Restrict disclosure of citizen identity and personal information based on actor role, access permissions, and request context.
1.37 Validate Identifiers Before Record Access
Input: Complaint ID, court case ID, security policy validation, authorization.
Output: Record ID validation result, record lookup permitted only for valid and authorized IDs.
Description: Verify identifier validity before record access to prevent incorrect targeting or erroneous record exposure.
1.38 Complaint Details Integration with Linked Criminal Information
Input: Valid complaint ID, actor credentials, linked criminal information existence, authorization scope.
Output: Complaint details display including linked criminal information summary, related court case information display when available, redaction outcome if required.
Description: Provide authorized users with complete linked case context when viewing complaint details while respecting access restrictions.
1.39 Role-Based Access Control for Complaint Viewing
Input: Actor role, complaint ID, requested data scope, access control rules.
Output: Viewing permission result, permitted data scope.
Description: Ensure only permitted actors can access specific complaint details based on role, complaint context, and requested data scope.
1.40 Allowed Investigation Status Transitions
Input: Complaint ID, investigation ID, current investigation status, requested investigation status.
Output: Validated investigation status transition result, transition allowed response, notification dispatch eligibility.
Description: Ensure investigation status changes follow predefined allowed transitions and prevent notifications from being sent for disallowed transitions.
1.41 Handle Investigation Status Update Without Linked Court Case
Input: Valid complaint ID, new investigation status, optional notes or evidence, court case linkage state.
Output: Investigation status updated, related court case status left unchanged, update reason recorded.
Description: Ensure investigation status updates do not create ambiguity when no active related court case exists.
1.42 Court Case Status Update Failure Handling
Input: Complaint ID, investigation status update request, linked court case status, court-case update failure details.
Output: Investigation status consistency result, rollback outcome, consistency handling outcome, failure log entry.
Description: Preserve consistency between investigation and court case statuses when a linked status update cannot be completed.
1.43 Investigation Status Update Failure Notification
Input: Investigation status update request, failure condition, involved complaint ID, involved court case ID.
Output: Failure notification to authorized actors, investigation progress status indicator, logged update failure record.
Description: Keep authorized actors informed of investigation status update failures to avoid operating on stale or inconsistent investigation progress.
1.44 Investigation Status Change Notification
Input: Complaint ID, new investigation status, related court case ID, citizen contact configuration.
Output: Stakeholder notification dispatch, citizen notification dispatch outcome, notification content reflecting status change, notification delivery record.
Description: Keep reporting citizens and relevant stakeholders informed when investigation status changes affect linked court case matters.
1.45 Validate Investigation Identifier for Case Operations
Input: Investigation ID, actor credentials, authorized role.
Output: Investigation identifier validity result.
Description: Verify that provided investigation identifiers correspond to the correct investigation for subsequent case actions.
1.46 Complaint-Court Case Linkage Integrity
Input: Complaint ID, court case ID, linkage action context.
Output: Linkage consistency response.
Description: Enforce consistent linkage between complaints and court cases for viewing, status synchronization, and court case updates.
1.47 Investigation Deletion Authorization Rules
Input: Complaint ID or investigation ID, actor credentials, access permissions, deletion confirmation, security policy validation.
Output: Authorized deletion decision, deletion permitted decision, deletion denied when unauthorized, deletion blocked reason provided, approved fallback action when applicable.
Description: Allow investigation record deletion only for actors that meet explicit deletion authorization rules and provide an approved fallback outcome when deletion is blocked.
1.48 Deletion Confirmation Failure Handling
Input: Removal confirmation, requested deletion, actor credentials, complaint ID or investigation ID.
Output: Deletion denied outcome, confirmation failure message.
Description: Prevent investigation deletion when removal confirmation is missing or invalid.
1.49 Investigation Deletion Eligibility
Input: Complaint ID, investigation record ID, requester role, current investigation status.
Output: Deletion allowed response.
Description: Ensure an investigation record can be deleted only when deletion eligibility conditions are satisfied.
1.50 Deletion Decision Respects Active Court Case Linkage State
Input: Active court case linkage state, complaint ID, investigation record deletion request.
Output: Linked active court case handling outcome, deletion permitted outcome policy, audit log entry for deletion decision.
Description: Prevent investigation record deletion from violating linked active court case handling rules.
1.51 Investigation Deletion Recovery
Input: Complaint ID, investigation ID, deletion request details, deletion attempt, failure reason, partial deletion indicators.
Output: Rollback confirmation response, deletion recovery outcome, restored records outcome.
Description: Recover from deletion failures or partial deletion attempts to keep related complaint, investigation, and court case records consistent.
1.52 Investigation Deletion Impact Notification
Input: Investigation ID, deletion request details, affected case identifier, affected court case linkage state.
Output: Deletion impact notification dispatch, notification content reflecting deletion impact, notification delivery record.
Description: Keep relevant stakeholders informed when an investigation is deleted in a way that impacts linked court case matters.
1.53 Criminal Information Registration Authorization
Input: Complaint ID, court case ID, criminal ID, requester role, requester assignment scope, actor credentials.
Output: Authorization decision, access denial reason recorded if denied.
Description: Permit criminal information registration and related actions only for requests authorized for the targeted complaint, criminal record, or court case.
1.54 Criminal ID Is Issued for Registered Criminal Information
Input: Valid complaint ID, criminal information data, criminal information ID.
Output: Criminal ID generated, criminal ID linked to criminal information record.
Description: Assign a unique criminal identifier to each registered criminal information entry for traceability.
1.55 Criminal Information Registration Consistency Recovery
Input: Criminal information input data, complaint ID, criminal identifier, criminal information registration error condition, court case linkage condition.
Output: Atomic registration failure result, rollback of partially created criminal information record, rollback of operation-scoped criminal record creation, preservation of existing complaint and court case records.
Description: Maintain data consistency when criminal information registration or operation-scoped criminal record creation cannot be completed successfully.
1.56 Criminal Information Registration Linkage Rollback Scope
Input: Complaint ID, court case linkage condition, criminal information linkage condition, registration failure reason.
Output: Linkage rollback outcome, preserved linkage outcome.
Description: Roll back all cross-record linkages created during a failed criminal information registration while preserving linkages that existed before the failed operation.
1.57 Criminal Information Linkage Fallback When Court Case Is Absent
Input: Complaint ID, criminal information data, available linkage state for investigation and court case, creation request context.
Output: Criminal information record stored, link status indicator, deferred linkage requirement indicator, audit record.
Description: Ensure criminal information can be recorded reliably through a controlled fallback when court case linkage or related case identifier is unavailable.
1.58 Criminal Linkage State Constraint
Input: Linkage state, criminal information data, court case availability.
Output: Valid linkage status, deferred linkage requirement indicator, rejected linkage state notice.
Description: Enforce only valid linkage states so criminal information linkage outcomes remain consistent.
1.59 Register Criminal Information May Trigger Investigation Progress Update
Input: Valid complaint ID, criminal information ID, investigation progress.
Output: Investigation progress updated, progress state stored.
Description: Update investigation progress when new criminal information is registered to maintain a coherent case timeline.
1.60 Criminal Records Action Log Captures Criminal Record Changes
Input: Criminal information ID, criminal ID, action performed, actor credentials.
Output: Criminal records action log entry created, action outcome recorded.
Description: Maintain an action history for criminal record operations to support audit and dispute resolution.
1.61 Criminal Profile Viewing Authorization Scope
Input: Criminal ID, requester role, requester assignment scope.
Output: Authorization decision.
Description: Restrict criminal profile viewing to requests authorized for the relevant case scope.
1.62 Criminal Profile Viewing Reflects Latest Criminal Information
Input: Criminal ID, criminal information ID, actor credentials, criminal records action log.
Output: Criminal profile displayed, latest criminal information included.
Description: Provide authorized actors with current criminal profile information based on the most recent valid records.
1.63 Criminal Profile Continuity When Criminal History Is Unavailable
Input: Criminal history, criminal profile ID, complaint ID, court case ID.
Output: Criminal profile, profile continuity status, missing history notice.
Description: Ensure criminal profiles remain usable when criminal history information is unavailable.
1.64 Criminal Profile Viewing Restriction on Credentials or Role Failure
Input: Actor credentials failure, role ID validation failure, criminal information ID, criminal ID.
Output: Criminal profile viewing restricted, access denial result returned, approved denial outcome for viewing, denied viewing reason recorded.
Description: Prevent unauthorized viewing of criminal profile information when actor credentials or role validation fails.
1.65 Use Criminal ID for Downstream Record Resolution
Input: Criminal ID, actor credentials, action type.
Output: Operation-scoped criminal record, criminal information record selected, resolved records returned.
Description: Use the criminal identifier to ensure criminal record operations and downstream actions apply to the intended criminal entity.
1.66 Criminal ID Referencing Across Case Workflows
Input: Criminal ID, complaint ID, court case ID, case ID.
Output: Criminal ID usage outcomes for linkage, deletion evaluation, and detail display.
Description: Ensure every case-related action consistently references the correct criminal record across the workflow.
1.67 Criminal Record Lifecycle Consistency
Input: Criminal record, criminal ID, creation request, update request, deletion request, actor role, view request.
Output: Criminal record creation result, updated record state, deleted record state, consistent criminal record state, compliant view outcome.
Description: Maintain controlled and consistent criminal record lifecycle behavior across creation, viewing, updating, and deletion scenarios.
1.68 Search Failure Fallback to Refinement Suggestion
Input: Search criteria, actor credentials, search failure condition.
Output: Search failure response, search refinement suggestion, no unauthorized profile data displayed.
Description: Ensure failed searches provide a clear corrective path without exposing unauthorized data.
1.69 Authorization-Scoped Linked Criminal Information Display on Case Lookup Failure
Input: Case identifier, actor credentials, case lookup result status, criminal profile viewing authorization scope.
Output: Scoped complaint details display outcome, linked criminal information summary redaction outcome, user-facing omission reason.
Description: Ensure users receive only authorization-scoped linked criminal information when case lookup cannot be completed.
1.70 Case Assignment Alternative Personnel Selection
Input: Complaint or court case ID, selected personnel ID, personnel availability state, required role criteria.
Output: Alternative personnel selection result, case assignment redirected to eligible personnel, assignment rejection reason when none available.
Description: Ensure cases can be assigned for investigation even when the initially selected personnel cannot receive the assignment.
1.71 Personnel Availability and Eligibility Requirements for Case Assignment
Input: Personnel ID, personnel status, case assignment target state.
Output: Eligibility result, eligibility denial reason.
Description: Restrict case assignments to police personnel who meet defined availability and eligibility criteria.
1.72 Personnel ID Propagation for Assignment Outcomes
Input: Selected personnel ID, complaint ID, court case ID, case ID, personnel availability state.
Output: Assignment outcome mapping, assignment rejection reason when ineligible.
Description: Ensure the selected personnel identifier is carried through assignment eligibility checks and outcome generation so results map to the correct intended assignee.
1.73 Personnel ID Access Authorization for Case Actions
Input: Personnel ID, actor credentials, requester role, required role criteria.
Output: Authorization decision for personnel-scoped operations.
Description: Ensure personnel-scoped actions are permitted only for authorized requesters.
1.74 Validate Personnel Identifiers for Assignment Role Scope
Input: Personnel ID, required role criteria, requester assignment scope.
Output: Assigned personnel ID, assignment rejection reason.
Description: Ensure personnel identifiers used in assignment actions are valid for the requested role scope.
1.75 Case Assignment Rollback on Assignment Failure
Input: Assignment request, complaint or court case ID, personnel ID, alternative personnel selection result, assignment failure condition, assignment failure record.
Output: Assignment completion status, prior assignment restoration indicator, consistency recovery confirmation, rollback of redirected assignment state, assigned personnel status reset.
Description: Prevent incorrect case ownership states by ensuring failed or redirected case assignment actions do not leave partial updates.
1.76 Unassigned Case with Escalation Path When No Eligible Personnel Exists
Input: Affected case identifier, alternative personnel selection result, none available condition, required role criteria.
Output: Unassigned case outcome, reassignment escalation requirement, case status change indicator.
Description: Ensure an affected case reaches a defined unassigned state with an escalation path when no eligible personnel is available.
1.77 Case ID Targeting for Eligibility, Recovery, and Notification
Input: Case ID, affected case identifier, complaint ID, court case ID.
Output: Eligibility evaluation outcomes, recovery correlation, notification targeting.
Description: Ensure eligibility, recovery, and notification activities correctly target the intended case.
1.78 Assignment Change Logging
Input: User assignments, assignment action, investigation record, actor credentials.
Output: Assignment log entry, updated assignment record.
Description: Record assignment changes to ensure assignment history remains auditable.
1.79 Assign Investigation Ownership to Eligible Personnel
Input: Complaint ID, personnel ID, role permissions, assignment constraints.
Output: Investigation ownership assignment.
Description: Ensure investigations are owned by eligible criminal police personnel based on assignment rules.
1.80 Personnel Identity Linking
Input: Personnel ID, complaint ID, investigation record, court case record.
Output: Linked personnel responsibility data.
Description: Ensure personnel identity is consistently associated with complaint, investigation, and court case ownership.
1.81 Link Feedback to Case Context
Input: Complaint ID, investigation ID, court case ID, feedback ID, feedback text, verified citizen identity.
Output: Case-linked feedback record.
Description: Capture feedback and associate it with the correct case context.
1.82 Control Feedback Submission Access
Input: Feedback submission actor, actor credentials, validated citizen identity, case ID.
Output: Feedback submission permission decision.
Description: Ensure only authorized actors can submit feedback for a given case.
1.83 Judgment Details Availability
Input: Judgment details, court case ID, investigation ID, actor credentials.
Output: Judgment details displayed to authorized viewers.
Description: Make judgment details available to authorized actors when viewing the related court case.
1.84 Judgment Details View Failure Fallback
Input: Judgment details view request, court case ID, investigation ID, failure condition.
Output: Failed view result, fallback view notice, viewing action log entry.
Description: Ensure authorized viewers receive a clear fallback outcome when judgment details cannot be displayed.
1.85 Court Case Search Results Enable Court Case Viewing
Input: Court case search module, search criteria, court case details.
Output: Search results returned, selected court case details view available.
Description: Allow authorized actors to retrieve and open court case details based on search criteria.
1.86 Validate Case ID and Handle Court Status Update Failure with Consistency Rollback
Input: Case ID, authorization, security policy validation, complaint ID, investigation status update request, court-case update failure details.
Output: Case ID validated, case status update permitted only for valid case ID, investigation status consistency result, rollback outcome.
Description: Ensure case identifiers are valid before applying status updates to court case records and preserve consistency when linked updates fail.

# Functional Requirement
## 1. Functional Requirements
---
## 1.1 Complaint Registration Function
**Function ID:** FR-01
**Description:** Citizens can register a new complaint with detailed incident information and supporting documents. The system validates the submitted data, verifies the citizen identity, generates a unique complaint ID, stores the complaint record, and provides a confirmation message.
**Input:** Incident description, location, incident date, supporting documents, citizen ID.
**Output:** A unique complaint ID, complaint record stored in the database, and confirmation message sent to the citizen.
---
## 1.2 Complaint Registration Failure Handling Function
**Function ID:** FR-02
**Description:** The system handles complaint registration failures by providing a clear failure message and a safe resubmission path. The system ensures that failed registration does not leave incomplete or ambiguous complaint records.
**Input:** Incident description, location, incident date, supporting documents, citizen ID, registration failure condition.
**Output:** Failed registration message, no incomplete complaint record created, and resubmission instructions provided to the citizen.
---
## 1.3 Supporting Document Validation Function
**Function ID:** FR-03
**Description:** The system validates supporting documents before accepting a complaint registration. The validation includes document availability, file type, file size, metadata, and upload integrity according to defined constraints.
**Input:** Supporting documents and document metadata.
**Output:** Document validation result, accepted document records, or document rejection message.
---
## 1.4 Complaint Identifier Propagation Function
**Function ID:** FR-04
**Description:** The system makes the generated complaint ID available for all complaint-related follow-up activities, including viewing complaint details, checking complaint status, initiating investigation, registering court cases, and submitting related updates.
**Input:** Complaint registration result, citizen ID, complaint ID.
**Output:** Complaint ID available for complaint-related operations and displayed in registration confirmation.
---
## 1.5 Complaint Identifier Lookup Function
**Function ID:** FR-05
**Description:** Authorized users can retrieve a complaint ID using valid complaint-related criteria when the complaint ID is not directly available.
**Input:** Complaint search criteria and user login credentials.
**Output:** Matching complaint ID, complaint reference information, or no-match message.
---
## 1.6 View Complaint Details Function
**Function ID:** FR-06
**Description:** Authorized users can view detailed information about a complaint, including incident description, location, date, status, related investigation information, notes, and linked court case information if available. The system logs the access action.
**Input:** Valid complaint ID and user login credentials.
**Output:** Complaint details displayed, related investigation and court case information displayed if available, and access log recorded.
---
## 1.7 Complaint Viewing Authorization Function
**Function ID:** FR-07
**Description:** The system ensures that users can only view complaint details when their role and relationship to the complaint allow access. Citizens can only view their own complaints, while Police Personnel and Administrators can view complaints according to their authorized scope.
**Input:** Complaint ID, user login credentials, user role, citizen ownership or assignment relationship.
**Output:** Access granted with complaint details displayed, or access denied message.
---
## 1.8 Complaint Notes Visibility Function
**Function ID:** FR-08
**Description:** The system provides authorized users with complaint notes and relevant investigation notes needed to understand and continue the complaint or investigation process. Sensitive or unauthorized notes are hidden based on role and access scope.
**Input:** Complaint ID, user login credentials, user role.
**Output:** Authorized complaint notes and investigation notes displayed.
---
## 1.9 Complaint Notes Change Notification Function
**Function ID:** FR-09
**Description:** The system notifies the citizen when complaint notes are added or updated and the change affects the complaint context. The notification is logged for traceability.
**Input:** Complaint ID, complaint notes update event.
**Output:** Citizen notification sent and notification log entry created.
---
## 1.10 Update Complaint Status Function
**Function ID:** FR-10
**Description:** Police Personnel and Administrators can update the status of a complaint and provide optional comments. The system validates the complaint ID, checks authorization, verifies the requested status transition, persists the update, records the status change in the complaint status log, creates an audit trail, and notifies the citizen.
**Input:** Valid complaint ID, current complaint status, new complaint status, optional comment, user login credentials.
**Output:** Updated complaint status stored in the database, complaint status log entry created, audit trail recorded, and notification sent to the citizen.
---
## 1.11 Complaint Status Transition Validation Function
**Function ID:** FR-11
**Description:** The system only allows complaint status changes that follow defined transition rules. Invalid or rejected transitions must not change the complaint status.
**Input:** Complaint ID, current complaint status, requested new complaint status, actor role.
**Output:** Status transition accepted and applied, or rejected transition message with no status change performed.
---
## 1.12 Complaint Status Update Authorization Function
**Function ID:** FR-12
**Description:** The system ensures that only authorized roles can update complaint status or perform complaint workflow actions such as escalation, note addition, or closure.
**Input:** Complaint ID, requested workflow action, user role, user login credentials.
**Output:** Authorization decision, permitted update scope, or denied action reason.
---
## 1.13 Atomic Complaint Status Update Function
**Function ID:** FR-13
**Description:** The system applies complaint status updates consistently so that the status update, status log, audit trail, and related notification are handled as one controlled operation. The system prevents partial or unlogged complaint status updates.
**Input:** Complaint ID, new complaint status, optional comment, status update request.
**Output:** Complete status update result, status log result, audit logging result, notification result, or rollback result.
---
## 1.14 Complaint Status Update Failure Recovery Function
**Function ID:** FR-14
**Description:** The system provides recovery when a complaint status update fails during validation, authentication, persistence, logging, notification, or dependent record update. The system ensures that stakeholders do not see a misleading partially updated state.
**Input:** Complaint ID, requested new status, error condition indicator.
**Output:** Status update failure message, rollback confirmation, final consistent complaint status, and retry guidance.
---
## 1.15 Complaint Status Retrieval Fallback Function
**Function ID:** FR-15
**Description:** The system provides a clear fallback response when a citizen or authorized user cannot retrieve the current complaint status.
**Input:** Complaint ID, status retrieval request, user login credentials.
**Output:** Complaint status displayed, or status unavailable message with retry recommendation.
---
## 1.16 Citizen View Complaint Status Function
**Function ID:** FR-16
**Description:** Citizens can view the current status and latest updates of their previously submitted complaints. The system verifies complaint ownership before displaying complaint progress.
**Input:** Valid complaint ID and citizen login credentials.
**Output:** Complaint status, investigation stage, recent updates, and related court case status if available.
---
## 1.17 Citizen Identity Linkage Function
**Function ID:** FR-17
**Description:** The system consistently links each complaint to the correct citizen identity so that only the correct citizen can access complaint updates and receive complaint-related notifications.

**Output:** Citizen ownership verification result and authorized citizen visibility outcome.
---

---

---

1.29 Complaint Submission Failure Handling
Input: Complaint submission details, complaint registration failure reason
Output: User-visible failure confirmation, registration result status, retry outcome or corrected submission prompt
Description: Ensure citizens receive a clear outcome and a recoverable path when complaint submission cannot be completed. When complaint registration fails, return a user-visible failure confirmation and provide a recoverable path such as a retry outcome or corrected submission prompt based on the failure reason. The system must not leave the complaint in an indeterminate state after a failed registration attempt; subsequent retries must be safe and lead to consistent results. If registration is only partially completed, the system must identify and revert all partial state changes and return a rollback confirmation along with submission retry eligibility.
1.30 Complaint Assignment Notification Fallback
Input: Complaint submission, notification delivery failure
Output: Notification delivery status, compensating delivery attempt result, assigned police personnel contact confirmation
Description: Ensure police personnel receive complaint assignment information even when initial notification delivery cannot be completed. If the initial notification delivery fails, provide a compensating delivery attempt (e.g., alternate channel or deferred re-delivery) and confirm assignment contact details. When all delivery attempts fail, produce a final notification failure confirmation and route the assignment to an alternative contact queue. Maintain clear notification delivery status and results for both the failed attempt and the compensating attempt.
1.31 Complaint Submission Validation
Input: Complaint required fields, supporting documents
Output: Validation result, rejection reason, submission outcome
Description: Ensure complaint submissions fail safely with clear rejection reasons when required information is missing or invalid. If a complaint identifier cannot be resolved for supporting document association, reject the submission safely with a clear reason rather than failing silently.
1.32 Investigation Case Lookup and Precondition Validation
Input: Investigation case ID
Output: Investigation case details, validity result, error message
Description: Enable users to retrieve an investigation case before performing case modifications. For any investigation update request, validate that the referenced investigation case ID exists and is eligible for updating. If the referenced investigation case is invalid, reject the update request and return a validity result indicating invalidity and a corresponding error message.
1.33 Investigation Update Atomicity and Audit Guarantee
Input: Investigation case ID, investigation case update request, update audit record status
Output: Atomic update result, audit record creation result, rollback executed result, inconsistency prevention confirmation
Description: Guarantee investigation updates and their audit trail are applied consistently as a single outcome. When an investigation update is successfully applied, ensure an audit log entry is recorded. If audit recording fails for a completed change, treat it as a failure condition so traceability is not silently lost. If update processing fails after any intermediate persistence, execute rollback and return a rollback executed result plus an inconsistency prevention confirmation to indicate the system has returned to a consistent state.
1.34 Investigation Status Transition Enforcement
Input: Investigation case ID, current status, requested new status, transition validity result
Output: Transition validity result, status-change side effects suppressed result, notification suppression result
Description: Prevent invalid investigation status changes by enforcing allowed transitions. The system shall evaluate whether the requested new status is a valid transition from the current status. Invalid transitions must be rejected before any side effects such as persistence or notifications occur. When a transition is invalid, suppress all notification side effects and return a notification suppression result confirming delivery was prevented.
1.35 Investigation Change Failure Classification and Recovery
Input: Investigation case identifier, proposed status change, proposed notes, proposed evidence, integrity check status, change request type, failure category
Output: Rejected change result, proposed update discard result, failure classification result, user-facing guidance result
Description: The system shall classify investigation change failures into distinct categories for consistent handling and prevent invalid investigation changes from being accepted. If integrity checks fail, reject the proposed change and discard the proposed update data so that none of the proposed fields or associations are persisted. Return a rejected change result, a proposed update discard result, a failure classification result, and user-facing guidance.
1.36 Investigation Update Recovery on Partial Failures
Input: Investigation case ID, update request details
Output: Update completion outcome
Description: Maintain consistent case state when investigation updates partially fail. If some sub-steps succeed and others fail, the system must either roll back all changes so the case state remains as before the update attempt, or apply updates in a transactionally consistent way. The system must not leave the investigation case in a partially updated state; return an outcome indicating whether the update completed successfully or failed, ensuring the persisted state matches the reported outcome.
1.37 Investigation-to-Court Status Synchronization
Input: Investigation status, investigation case ID, associated court case ID, court case status
Output: Updated court case progress state, court case status confirmation, synchronized status result
Description: Keep linked court case status aligned when investigation status changes. Court case progress changes must be derived only from the authoritative investigation status for the associated court case. If the investigation case identifier cannot be resolved, block synchronization and return a consistency failure reason to prevent court case progress divergence.
1.38 Stakeholder Notification After Investigation Update
Input: Audit record committed result, investigation status update request, operation identifier, stakeholder notification dispatch result, notification delivery status
Output: Stakeholder notification dispatch result, notification delivery status, retry outcome, operation identifier
Description: Ensure stakeholders are informed when an investigation update is committed and recorded. After the audit record indicates recording is completed, dispatch stakeholder notifications. If notification delivery fails, trigger a defined retry or deferral outcome rather than leaving the operation without a defined notification result. Return both the dispatch result and delivery status, including the retry outcome when applicable, tied to the operation identifier.
1.39 Criminal Record Modification Atomicity and Rollback
Input: Criminal record modification request, criminal record ID, audit record commit failure indicator
Output: Modification committed result, audit record committed result, modification rollback result, audit rollback result
Description: Ensure criminal record modifications and their audit records are both committed or both rejected. During criminal record modification, attempt to commit the audit record; if audit record commit fails, rollback any changes to the criminal record and return a modification rollback result. If audit-related changes were partially persisted, also perform an audit rollback so both the business data and audit trail remain consistent.
1.40 Criminal Record Change Notifications
Input: Criminal record creation or deletion event, associated investigation or court case ID, notification recipients, notification eligibility outcome
Output: Stakeholder notification dispatch result, notification delivery status, notification eligibility outcome
Description: Notify relevant stakeholders when a criminal record is added to or deleted from an associated case. Gate notifications by the related investigation status: notifications must be sent only when the related investigation is in a state that warrants stakeholder awareness. If notification delivery fails, trigger a defined retry or deferral outcome. Ensure notification delivery failures reach a definitive terminal status that can be audited.
1.41 Criminal Record Deletion Consistency and Rollback
Input: Criminal record ID, associated case identifier, deletion confirmation, linkage update failure status, operation rollback result
Output: Deletion notification to relevant stakeholders, linkage rollback result, updated case linkage state, linkage update suppressed result, administrator alert, deletion failure message
Description: Preserve data consistency when a criminal record deletion cannot be completed. If deletion fails, the criminal record and associated case linkage remain unchanged, and a failure message is returned with an audit entry. Associated case linkage state must be updated only when deletion completes without rollback. If post-deletion linkage updates fail, restore consistent linkage state and alert the administrator.
1.42 Operation-Level Authorization for Case and Record Management
Input: User identity, operation type, target identifiers, user role
Output: Authorization decision, permitted action result, denied action result
Description: Ensure only permitted users can perform investigation and criminal record operations. For each supported operation, evaluate the requesting user's identity and role against the operation type and relevant target identifiers, and return an explicit authorization decision. If unauthorized, deny the operation and return a deterministic denial outcome rather than proceeding.
1.43 Role-Based Court Case Viewing Authorization
Input: Court case ID, viewer role, viewing operation type, actor identity, identity verification status
Output: Authorization decision, denied reason category, court case details viewing result, user-visible denial confirmation
Description: Ensure every court case viewing request is authorized based on the requesting role and operation type. Apply field-level visibility rules to limit information returned based on role constraints. If identity verification fails, deny access and return a clear denial confirmation. If viewing criteria are invalid, provide a user-visible denial outcome rather than returning unauthorized data. Suppress court case details when authorization fails.
1.44 Court Case Viewing with Partial Data Availability

Description: Ensure court case viewing still provides a valid outcome when certain associated details (such as police personnel details) cannot be retrieved. Return available data with a message indicating the limited view rather than failing the entire request.
1.45 Case-Complaint Relationship Integrity
Input: Investigation case ID, associated complaint ID, new status, investigation notes
Output: Case-complaint relationship established or corrected, investigation status update applied only when relationship exists, logged linkage validation outcome

1.46 Personnel Eligibility Validation Before Assignment
Input: Police personnel ID, assignment request, personnel status
Output: Eligible personnel confirmation, ineligible personnel rejection
Description: Prevent assignment of cases to personnel who are not eligible to receive or manage case responsibilities. When generating notifications about missing role assignments, the system must evaluate the triggering user's identity and return either an authorization result or a denied result; notifications about role assignment gaps must not be triggered if authorization is denied. Missing role assignment events must be recorded for traceability.
1.47 Notification Delivery Retry and Terminal Failure Handling
Input: Notification delivery status, retry outcome, terminal notification failure state, update event, notification recipients
Output: Notification delivery status, terminal retry outcome, retry outcome
Description: Ensure every notification attempt concludes with a clearly trackable outcome when delivery cannot be completed. For notification attempts that cannot be delivered, set a terminal notification failure state and provide a terminal retry outcome so callers and recovery processes can distinguish between transient failure and terminal failure. Record a final, auditable result for the attempt.
1.48 Protected Viewing Audit Logging and Failure Recovery
Input: Viewing activity, viewer identifier, viewed record identifier, access timestamp, investigation case identifier, audit record creation result, viewing activity log failure outcome, operation identifier
Output: Viewing activity log entry, viewing activity acknowledgment, audit logging recovery outcome, viewing failure acknowledgment
Description: Maintain a record of protected data viewing events for post-incident review. For each protected viewing event, create an audit record associated with the investigation case identifier. If audit record creation fails, generate a defined audit logging recovery outcome and return a viewing failure acknowledgment so the system behavior is consistent. Ensure viewers receive a clear acknowledgment even when protected viewing or logging fails, rather than failing silently.
1.49 Administrator Notification on Criminal Record Operation Rollback
Input: Operation type, criminal record identifier, audit log dependency status, operation rollback result
Output: Administrator alert result, rollback notification delivered result
Description: The system shall notify the administrator whenever a criminal record operation is rolled back due to audit logging failure. If a criminal record operation must be rolled back because an audit logging dependency failed, the system must complete the rollback and notify the administrator with an explicit administrator alert result. The notification must be associated with the operation type and criminal record identifier, and administrator alerting must not be suppressed when rollback is triggered by audit logging failure.
1.50 Criminal Record Deletion Reflected in Audit and Investigation State
Input: Criminal record deletion event, audit record, investigation status update request
Output: Audit record committed result, investigation status update
Description: Ensure criminal record deletions are reflected in the case history and investigation state so downstream stakeholders see consistent progression. When a criminal record deletion occurs, ensure an audit record is committed and an investigation status update is applied so that the investigation and case state reflects the deletion and remains consistent for downstream consumers.
1.51 Criminal Modification Failure Reconciliation
Input: Criminal record modification request, modification failure reason, associated investigation ID, associated court case ID
Output: Failure notification status, case status reconciliation result, requester reconciliation confirmation, rollback execution status, affected handler notification outcome
Description: Ensure case status remains consistent for the associated investigation and court case when criminal information updates cannot be completed. When criminal modification fails, perform reconciliation of case status for the associated investigation and court case and confirm the outcome to the requester. If reconciliation fails, rollback any attempted state changes and provide rollback execution status. Ensure affected handlers receive a reliable failure notification, including compensating delivery attempt results. Produce a failure trace record for correlated failure events.
1.52 Link Personnel Identity to System Activities
Input: Personnel ID, system activity identifier, activity type, user ID, role selection, action identifier
Output: Linked personnel identity record, accounted activity reference, authorized action reference, access log entry
Description: Ensure every recorded system activity can be traced to the responsible police personnel and that each user action is governed by the correct permissions and recorded to the acting user identity.
1.53 Citizen Profile Completeness for Case Handling
Input: Citizen ID, citizen profile completeness status, complaint identifier, citizen profile, case reference
Output: Profile completion requirement status, notification eligibility outcome, citizen-facing information package, citizen profile-aligned case view
Description: Ensure complaint and investigation handling can proceed correctly only when valid citizen information is available. Provide accurate citizen details for case communication and citizen-facing case information retrieval. If the citizen profile is incomplete or unavailable, surface the issue to administrators and prevent incomplete handling.
1.54 Respect Citizen Notification Preferences

Description: Deliver only notifications that match the citizen's selected preferences for each notification event type.
1.55 Fallback Behavior for Invalid Filtering Criteria in Detail Views
Input: View type, view identifier, filtering criteria inputs, filtering criteria validation result
Output: Default filtering applied result, validation error response result, logged activity
Description: The system shall handle invalid filtering criteria without exposing unauthorized or incorrect case information. 1.56 Court Case Citizen Information Viewing Criteria Validation
Input: Court case ID, filtering criteria validity, citizen information access request, citizen identifier, viewer role, identity verification failure
Output: Valid criteria status, view permissions result, citizen information viewing result, identity verification result, access eligibility decision
Description: Prevent incorrect citizen information retrieval by ensuring viewing requests are only processed when required criteria are valid and the viewer's identity is verified. If criteria are invalid or identity verification fails, deny access and return a clear result without proceeding to citizen information retrieval.

Input: Criminal record modification failure, associated investigation ID, associated court case ID, notification recipients
