Description: Citizens can use the portal to check complaint or case progress, receive notifications, submit feedback, and access service-related communication features.
3.23 Citizen Contact and Notification Handling
Input: Citizen contact information, notification event, contact completeness status, notification channel availability
Output: Contact validation result, notification scheduling result, deferred notification outcome, alternate communication guidance
Description: The system validates citizen contact information before sending complaint or case notifications. If contact information is incomplete or unavailable, the notification is deferred or routed through an alternate handling process.
3.24 Criminal Record Management
Input: Suspect name, ID number, prior convictions, photo, updated criminal profile fields
Output: Created or updated criminal profile, criminal history display, updated reference indicators
Description: Authorized users can create, update, and view criminal profiles. The system maintains searchable suspect records and keeps related case references consistent when criminal profile information changes.
3.25 Criminal Record Update Propagation
Input: Suspect ID, updated criminal profile fields, related case references
Output: Propagation completion status, updated case reference indicators
Description: The system propagates approved criminal record updates to related case references so that investigations, court cases, and search results remain consistent.
3.26 Evidence Management
Input: Evidence ID, source, storage location, custodian, evidence file, evidence action
Output: Digital evidence archive, custody status, borrowing log, destruction workflow state, audit-log entry
Description: The system centrally manages physical and digital evidence. It supports evidence archiving, custody tracking, borrowing, destruction workflows, and traceability of evidence lifecycle operations.
3.27 Evidence-to-Investigation Linking
Input: Evidence ID, Case ID, investigation ID
Output: Link confirmation, linked evidence list, updated investigation evidence log
Description: The system maintains explicit associations between evidence and the investigations or cases it supports.
3.28 Evidence Custody Authorization and Transition Control
Input: Evidence ID, requested custody action, current custodian, target custodian, requesting user role
Output: Authorization result, allowed-action decision, custody status update, denial reason
Description: The system restricts evidence custody operations to authorized roles and enforces valid custody transitions for borrowing, transfer, return, and destruction actions.
3.29 Evidence Workflow Failure Recovery
Input: Evidence ID, workflow step, borrowing request, destruction request, failure condition, current custody state
Output: Workflow state restoration, corrected custody state, borrowing log correction, destruction halt outcome, workflow failure notice
Description: The system restores evidence workflow and custody state when borrowing, custody transfer, or destruction steps fail. Destruction is halted when the system cannot safely record or correct the workflow state.
3.30 Evidence Identifier Failure Handling
Input: Evidence identifier, attempted evidence action, user identifier, failure reason
Output: Evidence action rejection, evidence identifier failure audit entry, user-readable failure reason
Description: The system rejects evidence actions when the evidence identifier is missing or invalid and records the failure for traceability.
3.31 Incident Reporting
Input: Location, time, involved persons, preliminary assessment, officer account information
Output: Incident report record, supervisory approval status, routing result
Description: Officers can log incidents from the field. The system stores the incident report and routes it for departmental or supervisory approval.
3.32 Incident Reporting Failure Recovery
Input: Incident reporting attempt, failure reason, supervisory approval status, involved persons, location, time
Output: Failed incident status, approval placeholder state, resubmission eligibility, resubmission guidance
Description: The system keeps supervisory approval tracking consistent when incident reporting fails. Failed incident reports receive a placeholder approval state and may be marked eligible for resubmission when recovery is allowed.
3.33 Incident Approval Routing Failure Handling
Input: Incident ID, routing attempt, routing failure reason
Output: Approval status correction, routing failure notification, resubmission or escalation guidance
Description: The system corrects approval status and informs users when incident approval routing cannot be completed.
3.34 Mobile Integration
Input: Device GPS, voice input, camera, mobile case entry, offline cached changes
Output: Mobile case entry, real-time sync result, offline cache state, sync status
Description: Officers can use mobile devices for on-site investigations and incident reporting. Data is synchronized in real time when possible and cached offline when connectivity is unavailable.
3.35 Offline Synchronization Failure Handling
Input: Device cached changes, client submission batch, sync status, conflict or failure reason
Output: Retry queue status, reconciliation result, duplicate prevention outcome, user alert, terminal failure status if retries fail
Description: The system handles offline synchronization failures by preserving cached submissions, retrying synchronization, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate records, and providing a terminal failure outcome when retries cannot complete successfully.
3.36 External System Integration
Input: External API request, case data payload, sync attempt, external system response
Output: Data exchange result, API response, deferred sync state, retry schedule, delivery failure notification
Description: The system exchanges data with external government or judicial systems through standardized interfaces. If external integration fails, the system preserves the payload, defers synchronization, schedules retries, and notifies operators of delivery failure.
3.37 External Integration and Offline Reconciliation
Input: External integration failure event, offline synchronization failure state, client submission batch
Output: Retry schedule applied, reconciliation trigger timing, duplicate prevention outcome
Description: The system aligns external integration retry scheduling with offline reconciliation so that repeated sync attempts do not create duplicate or inconsistent case records.
3.38 Notification System
Input: Status change, approval completion, overdue alert, notification rule, recipient information
Output: SMS, email, push notification, notification delivery record, notification audit record
Description: The system automatically sends notifications to relevant parties based on defined rules and records notification generation and delivery outcomes for traceability.
3.39 Notification Trigger and Eligibility Control
Input: Case ID, new status, approval placeholder update, investigation state update, notification rule category
Output: Notification eligibility determination, triggered notification confirmation, notification suppression reason, notification audit evidence
Description: The system sends notifications only when configured trigger and eligibility rules are satisfied. If the triggering case or status cannot be identified or the action is invalid, the notification is suppressed and the reason is recorded.
3.40 Notification Failure Handling
Input: Notification identifier, recipient contact details, delivery result, notification channel availability
Output: Resend decision, alternate-channel plan, failure status, notification audit record
Description: The system handles notification delivery failures by recording the failure, retrying delivery when allowed, using alternate channels where available, and logging the outcome.
3.41 Failure Notification Access Control
Input: Failure notification type, recipient contact channel, requesting actor
Output: Allowed delivery decision, denied delivery decision
Description: The system ensures that failure notifications are generated and delivered only to authorized recipients.
3.42 Notification Trace Logging
Input: Notification attempt event, complaint identifier, notification channel, delivery result
Output: Notification trace log entry, notification attempt status result
Description: The system records notification attempt details for complaint failures, status changes, and other important system events to preserve accountability.
3.43 Multi-Language Support
Input: User-selected language preference, interface rendering context
Output: Interface rendered in chosen language, default language display result if preference cannot be applied
Description: The system supports multiple languages and renders the interface according to the user’s selected language preference. If the preferred language cannot be applied, the system displays a default language consistently.
3.44 Language Fallback After Access Control Recovery
Input: Access control failure state, user language preference, interface rendering language outcome
Output: Language fallback result, language reversion result, rendering consistency outcome
Description: The system keeps the interface understandable during and after access control failures by using a default language when necessary and reverting to the preferred language after recovery.
3.45 Data Export and Reporting
Input: Query criteria, export format, requesting user role
Output: Data report file, export status, audit-log entry
Description: Authorized users can export case data in standard formats such as PDF or Excel for analysis and higher-level reporting. The system checks export authorization and records the export action.
3.46 Export Query and Format Failure Handling
Input: Query criteria, export request, export format, validation result, diagnostics availability
Output: Fallback report, partial report, empty report with diagnostics, minimal fallback report, retry prompt, export failure status
Description: The system provides a usable report outcome or clear diagnostics when query evaluation, criteria validation, or report format generation fails. If full diagnostics are unavailable, the system provides a minimal fallback report and retry guidance.
3.47 Export Scope Enforcement
Input: Export request criteria, requesting user role, export scope enforcement result
Output: Allowed record set, export denial reason, safe denial result, redacted diagnostics, denial record
Description: The system limits exported data to the scope permitted for the requesting role. If scope enforcement cannot be completed, export is denied and no unauthorized data is included in output, diagnostics, or fallback artifacts.
3.48 Export Geographic Fallback
Input: Geographic criteria unavailable state, export query criteria, selected export format
Output: Report export result, locality-unknown grouping, export-display grouping consistency result
Description: The system keeps reporting deliverable when geographic criteria cannot be applied by grouping affected records as locality unknown and ensuring exported grouping matches the displayed fallback grouping.
3.49 Audit Trail
Input: User actions, system operations, actor identity, target identifier, operation outcome
Output: Audit-log entries containing timestamp, user ID, IP address if available, action type, target identifier, and result
Description: The system logs critical user and system actions for accountability, including creation, modification, deletion, access attempts, authentication failures, evidence lifecycle operations, incident events, court actions, notification attempts, exports, and sensitive workflow outcomes.
3.50 Audit Logging Failure Handling
Input: Required audit event, audit logging outcome, operation context
Output: Audit success record, fallback audit note, audit failure indicator, safe operation outcome
Description: The system ensures required audit events are recorded or explicitly marked when recording fails. Critical operations must not silently lose audit traceability.
3.51 Comprehensive Operation Permission Matrix
Input: Role, operation identifier, target record type, target field, security policy
Output: Allowed action list, denied action list, effective permission result
Description: The system defines and applies an operation-level permission matrix across complaints, investigations, court cases, evidence, criminal records, exports, notifications, citizen portal actions, and administrative functions.
3.52 System Configuration Management
Input: Configuration category, configuration ID, new settings, administrator credentials
Output: Updated system settings, configuration deletion or update result, confirmation message, audit-log entry
Description: Administrators can configure, update, or remove system settings such as notification preferences, access control rules, security policies, timeouts, and password policies according to authorization rules.
3.53 Security Feature Management
Input: Security feature name or ID, new status or settings, administrator credentials
Output: Updated security feature configuration, confirmation message, audit-log entry
Description: Administrators can enable, disable, or modify security features such as multi-factor authentication, CAPTCHA, session controls, or encryption settings.
3.54 Data Integrity Checking
Input: System data entities, linkage rules, consistency rules
Output: Data integrity report, flagged inconsistencies, correction recommendations, audit-log entry
Description: The system performs data integrity checks to verify consistency between complaints, investigations, court cases, criminal records, evidence, roles, access rights, and external synchronization states.
3.55 Data Integrity Report Viewing
Input: Data entity type, time range, filtering criteria, administrator credentials
Output: Displayed data integrity report, inconsistency details, viewing audit-log entry
Description: Authorized administrators can view system integrity reports and inspect flagged inconsistencies or errors.

Output: Displayed access logs, filtered activity records, viewing audit-log entry
Description: Administrators or authorized personnel can view access logs that show user activity and sensitive data access.

Output: Displayed access control policies, user permissions, viewing audit-log entry
Description: Administrators can view current access control policies, role permissions, and user-specific access rights.
3.58 Citizen Feedback and Satisfaction Channel
Input: Complaint ID, citizen account information, feedback content, satisfaction survey response
Output: Feedback record, confirmation notice, follow-up status
Description: Citizens can provide feedback or satisfaction survey responses through the citizen portal. Feedback is linked to the related complaint or case where applicable.

Functional Requirement
FR 1: Complaint Registration
Input: Incident details, date, time, location, crime type, citizen information, contact information, supporting documents
Output: Generated FIR number, complaint submission status, confirmation message, retry guidance when registration fails
Description: The system allows citizens to register complaints online or through supported offline/mobile channels. The system validates required incident and citizen information, checks submission eligibility, generates a unique FIR number only after successful validation, and sends a confirmation message to the citizen.
FR 2: Complaint Registration Failure Recovery
Input: Complaint registration request, validation result, FIR creation result, citizen information, failure reason
Output: Registration failure status, rejection reason, retry option, no permanent FIR record confirmation
Description: The system ensures failed complaint submissions do not create incomplete or misleading FIR, suspect, or case records. If validation or FIR generation fails, the system returns a clear failure reason, prevents partial records from being committed, and provides retry or correction guidance.
FR 3: Offline Complaint Submission Handling
Input: Offline form entry, citizen information, incident details, offline entry ID, failure reason
Output: Offline submission status, failure reason, linked FIR reference if generated, re-entry instructions
Description: The system supports offline complaint submission through mobile or field-entry workflows. If offline submission fails, the system records a clear outcome, provides re-entry or retry instructions, and reconciles the offline submission with a generated FIR when synchronization later succeeds.
FR 4: Complaint Confirmation Notification
Input: FIR number, complaint confirmation message, recipient contact information, notification delivery status
Output: Confirmation delivery status, retry attempt result, notification tracking update
Description: The system sends confirmation notifications for successfully registered complaints. If delivery fails, the system records the failure, retries delivery when appropriate, and maintains a traceable delivery status.
FR 5: FIR Tracking
Input: FIR number, citizen ID, tracking request
Output: Current FIR status, case details, FIR history, not-found response when applicable
Description: Users can track the progress of a complaint or FIR using an FIR number or citizen identifier. The system returns the latest available FIR status, case details, and consolidated history.
FR 6: FIR Tracking Failure and Fallback Handling
Input: FIR number, citizen ID, lookup result, citizen identity validation result
Output: Not-found response, limited tracking view, unavailable-data notice, user guidance message
Description: The system provides an unambiguous result when FIR tracking cannot be completed normally. If no matching FIR is found, the system returns a not-found response. If citizen identity lookup fails, the system may provide a limited tracking view while protecting restricted information.
FR 7: FIR Status Synchronization
Input: FIR number, updated FIR status, case history records
Output: Updated FIR tracking timeline, synchronized case history, status synchronization confirmation
Description: The system keeps FIR tracking details and history synchronized with the latest FIR status. When an FIR status changes, the system updates the tracking timeline and associated case history records.
FR 8: FIR Status Change Notification
Input: FIR number, status change event, citizen information, notification settings
Output: Notification delivery confirmation, notification message log
Description: The system notifies relevant parties when FIR status changes. Notification content and delivery metadata are recorded for traceability.
FR 9: Case Management
Input: FIR details, investigation notes, case status, evidence files, officer assignments, task details
Output: Updated case file, timestamps, pending action alerts, case history update
Description: Officers can update case status, add investigation notes, upload or link evidence, assign tasks, and maintain case progress. The system records updates with timestamps and keeps the case file current.
FR 10: Case Update Validation
Input: FIR number, case identifier, officer action type, update content, current case status
Output: Acceptance confirmation, validation error message, allowed update action set
Description: The system validates case context before accepting case updates. Updates are permitted only when the referenced case exists, is current, and is in a compatible state for the requested action.
FR 11: Case Status Workflow Enforcement
Input: Current case status, requested next status, FIR number, workflow rules
Output: Transition allowed or denied outcome, reason for denial, updated case timeline
Description: The system enforces valid status transitions for FIR and case workflows. Invalid status changes are rejected with a clear reason.
FR 12: Case Update Atomicity and Recovery
Input: Case update request, update component results, alert generation result, audit result
Output: Final case file state, rollback result, recovered audit record, consistency confirmation
Description: The system ensures related case updates are applied consistently. If a case update includes multiple components such as status, notes, task assignment, evidence metadata, history entries, or alerts, the system either applies the complete valid outcome or restores the case to a consistent state.
FR 13: Case Update Audit Trail
Input: Case identifier, FIR number, update details, requesting user, timestamp
Output: Persisted audit log entry, audit confirmation
Description: The system records every case update with actor identity, timestamp, target case, and update details to support accountability and later review.
FR 14: Task Assignment Handling
Input: Task assignment request, officer identity, case identifier, assignment failure reason
Output: Assignment result, unassigned task status, responsible officer alert, audit entry
Description: The system supports officer task assignment for cases. If assignment fails, the system records the failure, alerts the responsible officer or administrator, and prevents silent loss of work.
FR 15: Court Interaction
Input: Court orders, hearing dates, legal documents, hearing updates, court timeline information
Output: Updated court timeline, hearing reminders, court action audit entry
Description: Legal officers can manage court proceedings, submit court documents, update hearing schedules, and maintain court timelines linked to cases.
FR 16: Hearing Date Validation
Input: Case reference, court order, hearing date
Output: Validated hearing date, invalid hearing date marker
Description: The system validates hearing dates against the related case and court order before using them in the court timeline or reminder workflow.
FR 17: Hearing Reminder Management
Input: Court timeline, hearing date change indicator, reminder timing rules, notification settings
Output: Updated hearing reminders, reminder confirmation, fallback reminder status
Description: The system updates hearing reminders when court timelines, hearing dates, or court orders change. If normal reminder scheduling cannot be applied, a fallback reminder or pending action alert is produced.
FR 18: Missing Hearing Date Escalation
Input: Court timeline item, missing or unconfirmed hearing date, designated legal officers
Output: Missing hearing date alert, action assignment, escalation log
Description: The system notifies responsible legal officers when hearing dates are missing or cannot be confirmed and records the escalation for tracking.
FR 19: Court Update Notification
Input: Court timeline update, document submission event, hearing date change, associated FIR or case identifier
Output: Notification delivery record, reminder confirmation event
Description: The system notifies designated case or legal roles when court timelines, orders, documents, or hearing dates are updated.
FR 20: Criminal Profile Management
Input: Personal data, biometric data, criminal history data, profile status update
Output: Criminal profile, profile status, criminal history report
Description: The system maintains criminal profiles using personal, biometric, and historical information. Authorized users can create, update, and review criminal profiles.
FR 21: Criminal Profile Uniqueness and Matching
Input: Personal identifiers, biometric identifiers, matching criteria
Output: Profile match decision, duplicate prevention outcome
Description: The system enforces identity matching rules to prevent duplicate criminal profiles and maintain a single reliable profile for each individual where possible.
FR 22: Criminal Profile Status Workflow
Input: Criminal profile identifier, current profile status, target profile status
Output: Profile status update result, blocked transition reason
Description: The system manages criminal profile lifecycle states through valid status transitions. Invalid profile status changes are blocked.
FR 23: Criminal History Report Fallback
Input: Criminal profile query, biometric availability status, field data availability, matching criteria
Output: Criminal history report, data-quality indicator, explicit failure state when required data is unavailable
Description: The system returns a usable criminal history report when possible. If data is incomplete or biometric matching is unavailable, the report includes a data-quality indicator or returns a clear failure state.
FR 24: Suspect Management
Input: Suspect name, gender, age, contact information, initial charges, related case reference
Output: Suspect record ID, suspect-case association status
Description: The system supports suspect registration and links suspects to relevant cases for investigation.
FR 25: Suspect Linkage Validation and Propagation
Input: Suspect record ID, case identifier, linkage modification event
Output: Association confirmation, updated case summaries, updated search index, linkage history
Description: The system validates suspect-to-case associations before making them visible. When suspect linkage changes, related case views, search results, and linkage history are updated.
FR 26: Suspect Registration Failure Handling
Input: Suspect details, suspect record creation result, case linkage request
Output: No partial suspect-case linkage, error status, reattempt option
Description: The system prevents incomplete suspect records or invalid suspect-case associations from being persisted when suspect registration fails.
FR 27: Case Type Management
Input: Case type name, description, applicable legal statutes, case type identifier
Output: Updated case type list, acceptance status, validation error message
Description: Administrators can add, modify, or delete case types used during case creation. The system validates legal statute references and prevents invalid case type definitions.
FR 28: Case Type Lifecycle and Impact Rules
Input: Case type modification or deletion request, affected case list, lifecycle state
Output: Change success response, rejection reason, effective mapping for existing cases
Description: The system enforces constraints on case type changes. Case types in use cannot be changed or deleted in a way that corrupts existing cases; affected cases are preserved or mapped according to defined rules.
FR 29: Evidence Management
Input: Evidence name, type, file, metadata, upload time, uploaded by, related case identifier
Output: Evidence archive ID, evidence record, download or retrieval reference
Description: The system securely stores and manages digital evidence, supporting upload, retrieval, linkage to cases, and auditability.
FR 30: Evidence Upload Failure Recovery
Input: Evidence upload request, evidence file, evidence metadata, upload failure reason, case file
Output: Failed upload record, retry queue status, pending upload status, no orphaned evidence record confirmation
Description: The system handles evidence upload failures without creating misleading or incomplete case evidence. Failed uploads are recorded, queued for retry when appropriate, and not shown as successfully attached evidence.
FR 31: Evidence Upload Atomicity
Input: Evidence file, evidence metadata, case linkage request, upload result
Output: Upload confirmation, no orphaned evidence indicator, consistent case evidence state
Description: The system ensures evidence upload and case linkage are consistent. If upload fails, no evidence archive or case attachment is falsely persisted as available.
FR 32: Evidence Access and Modification Logging
Input: Evidence archive ID, user action, requesting user
Output: Evidence audit log entry
Description: The system records evidence access, upload, modification, and retrieval actions to support integrity and accountability.
FR 33: Evidence Retrieval Fallback
Input: Evidence archive ID, download link generation result, evidence availability status
Output: Download link availability status, retrieval alternative notice
Description: The system provides a safe evidence access outcome when a download link cannot be generated or evidence retrieval is unavailable.
FR 34: Advanced Search and Reporting
Input: Search filters, name, location, date range, crime type, report format
Output: Matching cases or persons, PDF or Excel report, no-results message
Description: Authorized users can search for cases, persons, and crime data using filters and generate reports in supported formats.
FR 35: Search and Report Authorization
Input: Search request parameters, report generation request, requesting user identity or role
Output: Authorized access result, authorization denial, allowed report scope
Description: The system restricts search and report generation to users authorized for the requested data scope.
FR 36: Search Filter Validation
Input: Search filters, filter value formats, required fields, date range
Output: Search execution result, validation error message, no-results or retry guidance
Description: The system validates search filters before executing searches. Invalid filters are rejected with clear error messages to prevent misleading results.
FR 37: Advanced Search Fallback
Input: Search request, search filters, advanced search failure state, user permissions
Output: Basic search results, empty state with retry guidance, fallback mode message
Description: If advanced search is unavailable, the system provides a basic search mode where possible while respecting permissions. If no fallback result can be produced, the system returns an empty state with retry guidance.
FR 38: Report Generation Fallback
Input: Report generation request, search failure state, query filters, requested report format
Output: Partial report, restricted report output, report failure notice, retry guidance
Description: The system provides a clear report outcome when report generation cannot be completed normally. It may return partial or restricted output when safe, or a failure notice with recovery guidance.
FR 39: Search and Report Audit Logging
Input: Search query parameters, report generation request, requesting user
Output: Search or report audit record
Description: The system records search and report generation activities for traceability and security review.
FR 40: Data Analysis and Statistical Reporting
Input: Time range, region, case type filters, crime data
Output: Graphical report, tabular report, crime trend analysis
Description: The system generates statistical reports and visualizations for crime trend analysis and policy planning.
FR 41: Trend Reporting Data Completeness Handling
Input: Criminal profile availability, biometric availability, time range, region, case type filters
Output: Trend report output state, data completeness notice
Description: The system provides crime trend reports with clear data completeness indicators when criminal profile or biometric data is unavailable.
FR 42: Role-Based Access Control
Input: User login credentials, user identity, user role, requested operation, target entity identifier
Output: Authorization decision, permitted operations, denied operations, access denial reason
Description: The system enforces role-based access to modules and operation-level permissions for sensitive actions.
FR 43: Operation-Level Authorization Matrix
Input: Role, operation type, target module, target entity
Output: Permitted operations list, denied operations list, authorization decision
Description: The system applies operation-level authorization across complaint registration, FIR tracking, case management, court interaction, suspect management, evidence management, search, reporting, and configuration functions.
FR 44: Identity Context Binding
Input: User identity, request action, user session
Output: Requesting user context, authorization decision result
Description: The system binds each request to the correct user identity so that authorization, audit logging, and user-scoped behavior are evaluated consistently.
FR 45: Valid Target Precondition for Operations
Input: FIR number, case identifier, suspect record ID, evidence archive ID, user session
Output: Operation allowed result, invalid-target error outcome
Description: The system verifies that referenced records exist and are eligible before processing operations on cases, suspects, evidence, reports, or court records.
FR 46: Configuration and Customization
Input: Administrator preferences, workflow settings, layout settings, notification settings
Output: Applied configuration, modified system behavior, configuration status
Description: Administrators can customize system layout, workflows, notification behavior, and local policing preferences according to regional or departmental requirements.
FR 47: Configuration Failure Fallback
Input: Configuration retrieval result, workflow settings, notification settings, affected module
Output: Default workflow behavior, default notification behavior, administrator failure notice
Description: The system continues safe operation when administrative configuration cannot be retrieved or applied. Default workflows or settings are used where appropriate, and administrators are notified of configuration failures.
FR 48: Automated Notification System
Input: Case status change event, FIR status change, hearing update, assignment change, notification settings
Output: SMS or email notification, delivery status record, notification event log
Description: The system sends automated notifications to relevant stakeholders when key events occur, including FIR status changes, case updates, court changes, hearing reminders, and assignment changes.
FR 49: Notification Recipient Resolution
Input: Notification event, FIR identifier, case assignment data, stakeholder roles, designated users
Output: Resolved recipient list, notification dispatch outcome, failure or partial outcome if recipients cannot be resolved
Description: The system determines notification recipients based on case assignments, stakeholder roles, citizen contact details, and configured notification rules.
FR 50: Notification Eligibility and Data Completeness Check
Input: Notification trigger event, required event fields, recipient data, notification settings
Output: Notification eligibility status, missing field warnings, suppression result
Description: The system sends notifications only when required event and recipient data are complete. If required data is missing, the notification is suppressed or marked incomplete with clear warnings.
FR 51: Notification Delivery Retry and Tracking
Input: Notification request, recipient contact, failure reason, notification attempt details
Output: Retry schedule, delivery status record, final delivery outcome, retry eligibility
Description: The system records every notification attempt and supports retry handling when delivery fails. Final notification outcomes are traceable.
FR 52: Notification Fallback Handling
Input: Notification event, primary channel failure, designated user resolution failure, channel availability
Output: Alternate notification outcome, fallback delivery status, failure notice
Description: The system attempts alternate delivery or records a fallback outcome when primary notification delivery fails or designated recipients cannot be determined.
FR 53: Notification Language Selection
Input: Notification message, recipient language preference, default language setting
Output: Selected language, localized notification content, language display status
Description: The system delivers notifications in the recipient’s selected language when available, or a default language when the preference cannot be applied.
FR 54: Multilingual Support
Input: User language preference, user identity context, supported language list
Output: Selected UI language, default language fallback, language display status
Description: The system supports multiple languages and displays the user interface in the selected language. If the preference is invalid or unavailable, the system uses a default language and informs the user.
FR 55: Mobile Application Functionality
Input: Camera input, voice recording, GPS location, offline form entry, mobile case data
Output: Locally stored field data, synchronized case data, sync status
Description: The mobile application supports offline case drafting, media capture, GPS capture, and automatic synchronization when connectivity is restored.
FR 56: Mobile and Offline Synchronization
Input: Offline form data, local update set, remote update set, sync attempt result
Output: Sync result, conflict resolution outcome, retry status, failure notice
Description: The system synchronizes offline data when connectivity returns. If conflicts or failures occur, the system records the sync status, resolves conflicts where possible, and provides user guidance.
FR 57: Case Ownership and Assignment Change Notification
Input: Case assignment change event, assigned user identifiers, case identifier
Output: Notification delivery status, assignment change notification log
Description: The system notifies relevant stakeholders when case ownership or task assignment changes and records the notification outcome.
FR 58: Audit Trail
Input: User action, system event, actor identity, target identifier, timestamp
Output: Audit log entry, audit retrieval confirmation
Description: The system logs sensitive and operational actions, including complaint registration, FIR updates, case updates, evidence actions, court updates, notifications, searches, reports, configuration changes, and authorization decisions.
FR 59: Access Attempt and Authorization Audit
Input: User identity, access attempt, permission decision, denied operation
Output: Access audit entry, denial audit entry
Description: The system records access attempts and authorization outcomes to support accountability and security review.
FR 60: System Recovery Outcome Logging
Input: Recovery event, rollback result, retry result, failure reason
Output: Recovery audit record, error resolution status
Description: The system records recovery outcomes for failed operations such as complaint registration, case updates, evidence uploads, notification delivery, and court reminder updates.

Functional Requirement
F1 User Registration
- Description: New users create an account by providing basic information.
- Input: Name, e-mail address, password.
- Output: Newly created user account; user can log in.
F2 User Login
- Description: Registered users authenticate with username/e-mail and password to access the system.
- Input: Valid username or e-mail address and associated password.
- Output: Authenticated user session and access to permitted system functions.
F3 Create Origin
- Description: Users can create new origin coordinates and address information.
- Input: Origin details, address, name, coordinates.
- Output: New origin stored in the database.
F4 Manage Origin
- Description: Authorized administrators can create, read, update, or delete origin records in the system.
- Input: Origin identifier, origin details, update data, delete command, administrator identity.
- Output: Created, updated, retrieved, or deleted origin record.
F5 Create Destination
- Description: Users can create new destination coordinates and address information.
- Input: Destination details, address, name, coordinates.
- Output: New destination stored in the database.
F6 Manage Destination
- Description: Authorized administrators can create, read, update, or delete destination records in the system.
- Input: Destination identifier, destination details, update data, delete command, administrator identity.
- Output: Created, updated, retrieved, or deleted destination record.
F7 Plan Route
- Description: Users obtain City-Mapper-recommended routes from an origin to a destination.
- Input: Origin details, destination details, selected transport mode, user preferences, available traffic data.
- Output: Recommended routes.
F8 Select Transport Mode
- Description: Users choose a transport mode for route planning, timetable lookup, distance calculation, and travel time estimation.
- Input: User identity, transport mode selection, origin, destination.
- Output: Stored transport mode choice and selected mode applied to route analysis.
F9 Distance Query
- Description: Users query straight-line or road distance between an origin and a destination.
- Input: Origin details, destination details, available coordinates.
- Output: Distance in kilometers or miles.
F10 Calculate Travel Time
- Description: Users compute estimated travel time from origin to destination based on selected transport mode, route data, preferences, and traffic availability.
- Input: Origin, destination, transport mode, user preferences, traffic data source.
- Output: Estimated travel time and traffic-data usage status.
F11 Set User Preferences
- Description: Users configure routing and transport preferences.
- Input: Preference data, preferred transport modes, route preferences, user identity.
- Output: Stored user preferences.
F12 Real-Time Traffic Update
- Description: The system ingests and reflects real-time traffic conditions in the application.
- Input: External real-time traffic data feed.
- Output: Latest traffic information stored and made available for route and travel time computation.
F13 Query Timetable
- Description: Users query timetables for relevant transport modes.
- Input: Transport mode, stop name, route, date, time, origin, destination.
- Output: Matching timetable information.
F14 Explore Points of Interest
- Description: Users browse or search points of interest such as attractions, restaurants, services, and landmarks.
- Input: POI query criteria, category, location, origin, destination, trip area.
- Output: POI search results including name, address, category, and availability status.
F15 Create and Manage Admin Account
- Description: Authorized privileged users can create, update, disable, or delete administrator accounts.
- Input: Admin account details, update request, delete request, requester identity.
- Output: Created, updated, disabled, or deleted admin account status.
F16 Log User Preferences
- Description: The system records and updates user preference settings for traceability and personalization.
- Input: User preference choices, preference update request, user identity.
- Output: Persisted user preference log.
F17 Log Real-Time Traffic Data
- Description: The system stores traffic update attempts and refreshes real-time traffic records.
- Input: Traffic data source, traffic update attempt, ingestion outcome.
- Output: Latest real-time traffic log and traffic ingestion audit record.
F18 Administrative Operation Authorization
- Description: The system restricts origin, destination, traffic, and administrator account management operations to authorized administrator roles.
- Input: Requester identity, administrator account identifier, operation type, target entity identifier.
- Output: Authorization decision, denial reason when unauthorized.
F19 Origin and Destination Administration Failure Handling
- Description: The system ensures origin and destination administration operations fail safely when authorization, account validation, or persistence fails.
- Input: Requested origin or destination management action, administrator identity, failure reason.
- Output: Denied or failed action result, preserved prior record state, user-visible failure message.
F20 Admin Account Change Failure Recovery
- Description: The system prevents administrator account changes from leaving accounts in an inconsistent state.
- Input: Admin account change request, administrator identifier, current account status, failure reason.
- Output: Failure outcome, unchanged or restored account state, retry or escalation status.
F21 Permission and Administrative Change Audit
- Description: The system records administrator account changes, permission changes, and administrative approvals for traceability.
- Input: Administrator identifier, requester identity, approval action, permission update, pending update status.
- Output: Audit log entry.
F22 Transport Mode Selection Precondition
- Description: The system requires an authenticated user context before saving transport mode selections or preference-dependent route settings.
- Input: Transport mode selection request, user authentication state.
- Output: Precondition validation result, saved selection or rejection message.
F23 Transport Mode Selection Fallback
- Description: The system provides a usable routing, travel time, and timetable outcome when transport mode selection fails.
- Input: Transport mode selection failure indicator, last valid transport mode, default transport mode, origin, destination.
- Output: Fallback transport mode applied, degraded route or timetable result, user-visible fallback notice.
F24 Timetable Fallback Handling
- Description: The system supports timetable lookup when the selected transport mode cannot be applied.
- Input: Transport mode selection failure indicator, last valid transport mode, timetable query criteria.
- Output: Matching timetable information using fallback mode, or timetable unavailable outcome when no fallback mode exists.
F25 User Preference Persistence Recovery
- Description: The system prevents lost, partial, or inconsistent user preference updates.
- Input: Preference save attempt identifier, preference update request, persistence outcome, existing preferences.
- Output: Save success or failure result, restored last valid preference state, user-visible message.
F26 User Preference Rollback
- Description: The system rolls back partially applied preference changes so travel time and route computation use consistent parameters.
- Input: Preference save attempt identifier, partially applied preference state, prior valid preference state.
- Output: Restored prior user preference state, safe travel time computation parameters.

- Description: The system provides a defined distance or route outcome when destination details or coordinates are unavailable.

- Output: Distance query result using fallback coordinates, or distance unavailable outcome with non-distance route planning result.

- Description: The system updates dependent route, distance, travel time, and preference records when an origin or destination is deleted.
- Input: Deleted origin identifier, deleted destination identifier, dependent record references.
- Output: Updated dependent data state, removed or adjusted invalid references.
F30 Origin or Destination Deletion Failure Fallback
- Description: The system preserves route planning and distance query correctness when an origin or destination deletion fails.
- Input: Delete command outcome, origin identifier, destination identifier, affected route planning request.
- Output: Stable route planning result, stable distance query result, user-visible fallback notification.

- Description: The system uses the best available traffic data when real-time traffic updates fail.
- Input: Real-time traffic feed status, ingestion failure condition, last known traffic availability, last known traffic timestamp.
- Output: Chosen traffic data source, fallback traffic outcome, degraded traffic status.

- Description: The system determines whether traffic data is fresh enough to be used for route planning and travel time estimation.
- Input: Traffic record timestamp, last successful traffic update time, freshness status, validity signals.
- Output: Traffic validity outcome, traffic serving mode, traffic usable or unusable outcome.

- Description: The system still provides a travel time estimate when current traffic data is unavailable.
- Input: Origin, destination, transport mode, last known traffic data, traffic freshness result.
- Output: Travel time estimate based on last known traffic data, degraded estimate notice.

- Output: Traffic unavailable outcome, non-traffic route planning result, user-visible traffic unavailability message.
F35 Traffic Unavailability Notification
- Description: The system informs users when traffic-aware results are unavailable or degraded.
- Input: Traffic ingestion failure condition, last known traffic availability, chosen traffic data source.
- Output: User-visible traffic data unavailability or degraded-data message.
F36 Traffic Freshness Propagation to Route Planning
- Description: The system ensures route planning behavior aligns with traffic validity and serving mode.
- Input: Traffic information validity outcome, traffic serving mode, route planning request.
- Output: Route planning traffic-mode outcome.
F37 Traffic Ingestion Audit Trail
- Description: The system records traffic ingestion attempts and outcomes for traceability.
- Input: Traffic update attempt identifier, traffic data source, ingestion outcome.
- Output: Persisted traffic ingestion audit record.
F38 POI Exploration Fallback
- Description: The system provides degraded POI results when full POI exploration cannot be completed.
- Input: POI query criteria, POI search failure indicator, origin, destination, trip area.
- Output: Retrieved POI category results or address results, degraded POI result outcome.
F39 POI Degraded Result Notification
- Description: The system informs users when POI category or address results are returned under degraded availability conditions.
- Input: POI search failure indicator, retrieved POI category results, resolved POI address results.
- Output: Degraded POI category notice, degraded POI address notice.
F40 POI Fallback Scope Constraint
- Description: The system keeps fallback POI results relevant to the intended trip area when route planning or POI exploration fails.
- Input: Route planning outcome, origin, destination, POI query criteria.
- Output: POI results within intended geographic trip area.

F42 Logging Consistency Recovery
- Description: The system keeps primary records and their associated logs consistent when logging fails.

- Description: The system notifies users when route, distance, timetable, POI, or traffic results are produced using fallback or degraded data.

Functional Requirement
FR-01 Create New Email
Description: Users can compose a new email and choose whether to save it as a draft or send it immediately.
Input: User info, recipient info, subject, body, attachment(s), send-now flag.
Output: New email saved to Drafts or sent to specified recipients.
FR-02 Validate Recipient Information Before Save or Send
Description: The system validates recipient information before saving or sending an email to prevent unusable or incorrect delivery targets.
Input: User info, recipient information, send-now flag.
Output: Recipient validation status, invalid recipient list, operation blocked when recipients are invalid.
FR-03 Preserve Draft Content on Save or Send Failure
Description: The system preserves the latest available draft content when saving or sending fails so users do not lose composed messages.
Input: User info, email info, draft content, send-now flag, save or send failure reason.
Output: Draft retained, recreated, or restored to the last known saved state.
FR-04 Send Email
Description: Users send an already-created email.
Input: User info, email info.
Output: Email delivered to recipients; copy updated in Sent folder.
FR-05 Handle Email Delivery Failure
Description: When delivery fails, the system records the failure, preserves a retryable or editable email state, and informs the user of the delivery outcome.
Input: User info, email info, delivery status, failure reason.
Output: Delivery failure recorded, email kept in Drafts or returned to editable state, user-visible failure result displayed.
FR-06 Maintain Sent Copy Consistency
Description: The Sent folder must accurately reflect delivery results and must not imply successful delivery when sending fails.
Input: User info, email identifier, delivery attempt result.
Output: Sent folder copy created only on successful delivery, or sent status corrected when delivery fails.
FR-07 Fallback Recipient Handling When User Context Is Unavailable
Description: When user context required for recipient resolution is unavailable, the system prevents unsafe or incomplete delivery.
Input: User info, recipient info, distribution group info, user context status.
Output: Send operation blocked or deferred, message saved to Drafts, unresolved recipient state retained.
FR-08 Validate Email Ownership Before Send or Delete
Description: The system ensures that only emails owned by or accessible to the requesting user can be sent or deleted.
Input: User info, email info, requested operation.
Output: Operation permitted or rejected.
FR-09 Receive Email
Description: Users can view and read incoming messages.
Input: User info, email info.
Output: Email displayed to user; read status updated where applicable.
FR-10 Mailbox Reception Readiness
Description: A mailbox can receive incoming mail only after its activation and readiness prerequisites are satisfied.
Input: Mailbox account info, mailbox activation status, activation prerequisite status.
Output: Mailbox reception enabled status or activation failed status with user-visible reason.
FR-11 Read Status Update
Description: Users can mark messages as read or unread and receive visible confirmation of the status change.
Input: User info, email info, desired read status.
Output: Email read status updated and displayed.
FR-12 Read Status Failure Feedback
Description: If read status cannot be applied because user or mailbox context is unavailable, the system informs the user.
Input: User info, email info, read status request, context availability.
Output: Read status not applied indicator, user-visible status message.
FR-13 Format Email
Description: Users can format email content.
Input: User info, email info, formatting operation.
Output: Formatted email saved to Drafts or Inbox.
FR-14 Preserve Content on Formatting Failure
Description: If formatting fails, the system preserves original email content and prevents partial formatting changes from corrupting the message.
Input: User info, email info, formatting operation, formatting failure reason, original content.
Output: Original email content preserved, formatting failure status displayed.
FR-15 Search Email
Description: Users can search messages by keyword and supported criteria.
Input: User info, search keyword(s), query criteria.
Output: Search-result list displayed to user.
FR-16 Email Search Status Filtering
Description: Email searches can apply current status filters so results reflect the latest email state.
Input: User info, query criteria, status filter criteria.
Output: Search-result list matching current email status.
FR-17 Email Search Failure and No-Result Feedback
Description: When search criteria are invalid, message content is unavailable, or no results exist, the system provides clear feedback.
Input: User info, query criteria, message availability, search failure reason.
Output: Search results, no-results message, or search validation feedback.

Description: Search results are restricted to records the requester is authorized to access.
Input: Requester identity, search criteria, user access rights.
Output: Authorized search results only.

Description: Email search is allowed only when the mailbox is ready to provide reliable results.
Input: User info, mailbox activation status, query criteria.
Output: Search result list or search failure explanation.

Description: Users can retrieve matching archived emails through the supported search experience when archive scope is available.
Input: User info, search keyword(s), personal archive scope.
Output: Search-result list including eligible archived email entries.

Description: Users can create, rename, delete folders and move messages.
Input: User info, folder-operation info, email info.
Output: Folder structure updated; message location updated.
FR-22 Validate Folder Targets
Description: Folder operations are performed only when the target folder is valid, accessible, and permitted for the user.
Input: User info, folder-operation info, target folder, email info.
Output: Folder validation status, allowed or denied operation result.
FR-23 Roll Back Folder Operations on Failure
Description: When folder operations fail, the system restores folder structure and message placement to a consistent state.

Output: Folder structure reverted, message location reverted, consistent mailbox state.
FR-24 Notify Folder Operation Results
Description: Users receive confirmation or error feedback after folder management operations.
Input: User info, folder-operation info, operation outcome.
Output: User-visible confirmation or error feedback.
FR-25 Fallback Folder for Unavailable Folder Targets
Description: When a requested folder destination cannot be used, the system applies a safe fallback placement according to system rules.
Input: User info, folder-operation info, email info.
Output: Default folder selected, message placement completed or clearly reported.

Description: Moving messages between folders must not incorrectly alter read, delivery, archive, or other message status flags.
Input: User info, email info, folder move operation.

FR-01 Register Asset
Description: Users fill in the asset registration form and submit it. The system validates the data for completeness and accuracy, stores the asset in the database, and sets the status to “Registered.” Administrators are notified for review.
Input: Completed registration form (asset name, type, quantity, purchase date, etc.).
Output: Stored asset record with status “Registered.”
FR-02 Asset Registration Validation Failure Handling
Description: The system rejects asset registration submissions that fail required validation checks and prevents invalid asset records from being staged for approval or stored.
Input: Asset form submission, validation rules, validation error details.
Output: Rejected submission with status “Validation Error.”
FR-03 Asset Registration Review Notification Failure Recovery
Description: If administrator review notification fails after asset registration artifacts are created, the system marks the review-ready artifacts invalid or reverts the registration status so the registration does not remain in an unreviewable partial state.
Input: Asset registration form, admin review notification, registration artifact creation status.
Output: Registration status reverted, review-ready artifacts marked invalid, failure result returned.
FR-04 Notify Registrants of Registration Outcome
Description: The system notifies registrants when their asset registration is accepted, rejected, or cannot be completed.
Input: Registration outcome, asset ID, requester identity.
Output: Registration outcome notification delivery.

Description: Users edit registered asset details and submit the change. The system validates the data, stages the change for admin approval, and updates the status to “Modified” upon approval.
Input: Completed modification form (editable fields such as name, type, quantity, purchase date).
Output: Updated asset record with status “Modified.”
FR-06 Asset Modification Validation Failure Handling
Description: The system provides a clear failure outcome when asset modification validation fails and prevents invalid modification requests from being staged or applied.
Input: Modification form, validation errors, requester identity.
Output: Modification request failure outcome.

Input: Approval-start request, asset modification request.
Output: Workflow status, approval status details.
