Output: Validation result, report generation eligibility status.
Description: The system rejects report generation requests with invalid date ranges.
FR-44 Deterministic Report Dataset Selection
Input: Report criteria, event inclusion rules.
Output: Report generation dataset identifier.
Description: The system uses deterministic selection of relevant records for each generated report.
FR-45 Report Data Source Consistency
Input: Report parameters, data freshness policy.
Output: Report snapshot timestamp.
Description: The system generates reports from a well-defined consistent data snapshot.
FR-46 Report Generation Eligibility Gating on Asset Availability State
Input: Date range, asset type, report requester user ID, asset return attempt status.
Output: Report generation eligibility status, report result metadata.
Description: The system ensures generated reports reflect the correct asset availability state when asset return operations fail.
FR-47 Report Generation Fallback When File Storage Is Unavailable
Input: Date range, asset type, user ID, export request, file storage failure condition.
Output: Report delivery fallback outcome, report content availability outcome.
Description: The system provides report results through a fallback delivery mechanism when report file storage is unavailable.
FR-48 Report Export Failure Fallback
Input: Report generation request, selected export format, exportable report content, date range, asset type.
Output: Report export rejection with reason, available fallback report output, audit trail entry.
Description: The system provides a controlled outcome when export format handling fails so administrators can still obtain usable report results.
FR-49 Access Generated Report Content on Export Failure
Input: Report generation request, export format, selected date range, asset type.
Output: Report content available in default view, export rejection with reason, audit trail entry.
Description: The system provides access to usable report content when a specific export format cannot be generated.
FR-50 Report Generation Emergency Outcome When Fallback Fails
Input: Date range, asset type, user ID, export request, report generation failure condition.
Output: Report failure outcome, report delivery alternative outcome.
Description: The system defines a deterministic outcome when report generation cannot be completed even after fallback.
FR-51 Report Generation Failure Rollback
Input: Report generation request, selected date range, asset type.
Output: Report generation rollback performed, invalid partial artifact removal indicator, audit trail entry.
Description: The system ensures incomplete report artifacts are not left available when report generation fails.
FR-52 Audit Trail Preservation on Report Export Storage Failure
Input: Report generation request, exportable report, storage failure.
Output: Audit trail entry creation status, audit trail entry content.
Description: The system preserves an audit trail for report export attempts even when exported files cannot be stored.
FR-53 Audit Trail Consistency Recovery on Report Export Storage Failure
Input: Report generation request, storage failure, audit trail entry creation status.
Output: Audit trail entry correction status, corrected audit trail entry content.
Description: The system ensures audit trail entries remain accurate after report export storage attempts fail.
FR-54 Report Access When Requester Identity Is Unavailable
Input: Report generation request, requester user ID, selected date range, asset type.
Output: Export access denied, identity unavailable reason, audit trail entry.
Description: The system denies report content access when requester identity cannot be validated during export-failure recovery.
FR-55 Permission Allocation
Input: User role, permissions to assign.
Output: Updated user permissions.
Description: System administrators can assign different levels of access to users based on their roles.
FR-56 Authorization for Permission Assignment
Input: User role, permissions to assign, requester user ID.
Output: Permission assignment permitted or denied, authorization decision log entry.
Description: The system restricts permission allocation actions to users authorized to administer permissions.
FR-57 Permission Revocation and Removal
Input: User role, permissions to remove, requester ID.
Output: Updated user permissions, permission removal outcome.
Description: The system allows administrators to remove previously granted permissions from a user.
FR-58 Permission Assignment Partial Failure Handling
Input: User role, requested permission set, permission assignment failures.
Output: Permission update status, failed permission list.
Description: The system rejects or corrects permission assignments when any requested permissions cannot be applied.
FR-59 Permission Assignment Rollback
Input: User role, permissions to assign, requester user ID.
Output: Permission assignment rolled back, partial update prevention indicator, audit trail entry.
Description: The system reverts permission assignment changes when the permission update cannot be completed.
FR-60 Approval Workflow
Input: Request type, requester ID, asset ID.
Output: Status update, approved or rejected.
Description: Certain actions require multi-level approvals. The workflow must be configurable and traceable.
FR-61 Approval Approver Determination
Input: Approval request, asset ID, organization context, approval policy.
Output: Approver selection status, approver recipient list.
Description: The system determines the correct approvers for each approval request based on applicable policy rules.
FR-62 Approval Decision Audit Logging
Input: Approval action, approver identity, request type, asset reference, decision timestamp.
Output: Audit log entry.
Description: The system maintains a tamper-evident record of approval decisions for traceability.
FR-63 Approval Outcome Logging and Notifications
Input: Approval request ID, approval status, requester identifier, approver identifier.
Output: Persisted approval event record and notification delivery status.
Description: The system records approval outcomes and notifies relevant stakeholders of the final status.
FR-64 Approval Status Change Notification
Input: Request type, requester ID, asset ID, status update, approval decision.
Output: Approval notification outcome, status change communication outcome.
Description: The system notifies relevant requesters when an approval decision is applied.
FR-65 Approval Workflow State Change Notifications
Input: Request status update, requester ID, approval request.
Output: Notification delivery status, notification recipients.
Description: The system notifies relevant users whenever an approval request status changes to approved or rejected.
FR-66 Approval Request Timeout Resolution
Input: Approval request identifier, timeout policy parameters.
Output: Approval request resolved status.
Description: The system resolves long-running approval requests to a defined final outcome.
FR-67 Approval Handling When Role-Based Authorization Cannot Be Resolved
Input: Request type, requester ID, asset ID, role resolution failure condition.
Output: Approval workflow outcome fallback, status update outcome.
Description: The system defines a deterministic approval workflow outcome when role-based authorization cannot be resolved.
FR-68 Authorization Precondition for Approval Workflow Notifications
Input: Approval request, requester ID, notification recipients.
Output: Notification delivery eligibility status, notification rejection reason.
Description: The system delivers approval workflow notifications only when recipient roles can be reliably determined.
FR-69 Approval Request Notification for Authentication Verification Failure
Input: Approval request, requester user ID, destination recipient identifier, notification attempt.
Output: Notification failure record, alternate notification target selection result, requester notification result.
Description: The system notifies relevant users when an approval request cannot proceed because authentication verification fails.
FR-70 Approval Request Recovery When Notification System Fails
Input: Approval request, requester user ID, destination recipient identifier, request type.
Output: Requester notified of notification failure, manual acknowledgment required indicator, audit trail entry.
Description: The system provides an explicit recovery outcome when approval request notifications cannot be delivered.
FR-71 Approval Request Unreachable Recovery
Input: Approval request, requester user ID, destination recipient identifier.
Output: Requester notified of inaccessibility, manual acknowledgment required indicator, audit trail entry.
Description: The system provides a defined recovery outcome when notification delivery for an approval request cannot be completed.
FR-72 Approval Persistence Failure User Notification
Input: Approval request failure condition, requester ID, transfer state rollback outcome.
Output: User-visible error outcome, failure reason communication outcome.
Description: The system notifies requesters when a transfer cannot complete because approval state could not be saved.
FR-73 Notification Retry and Fallback Handling
Input: Notification type, recipient identity, notification payload.
Output: Notification delivery status.
Description: The system ensures notifications reach recipients through retries or fallback delivery when primary sending fails.
FR-74 Data Import and Export
Input: File, format options.
Output: Imported asset records or exported data file.
Description: The system supports bulk import and export of asset data in standard formats.
FR-75 Bulk Import Error Handling With Rejected Row Reporting
Input: Import file, row identifier, validation rule, error details.
Output: Import result summary and rejected row report.
Description: The system provides a clear import result summary and safely handles invalid data during bulk import.
FR-76 Bulk Import Failure Handling
Input: Import file, validation results, import job identifier.
Output: Import outcome summary.
Description: The system handles bulk import failures with defined recovery behavior and an import outcome summary.
FR-77 Reconciliation of Asset Records After Bulk Import Failure
Input: Bulk asset data import, import failure, asset records.
Output: Asset record reconciliation status, reconciled asset records.
Description: The system ensures the asset inventory remains consistent after bulk data import attempts fail.
FR-78 Upload Retry Eligibility After Rollback
Input: Upload request, file reference identifier.
Output: Retry eligibility indicator, cleared dependent artifact state, audit trail entry.
Description: The system allows safe user retry of failed uploads by defining retry eligibility after rollback has occurred.
FR-79 Stakeholder Notification When Rollback Retry Eligibility Is Updated
Input: Upload request, file reference identifier, retry eligibility indicator.
Output: Requester notification of retry eligibility update, audit trail entry.
Description: The system informs the requester when rollback-related retry eligibility changes.
FR-80 Upload Retry Eligibility When Requester Identity Is Unavailable
Input: Upload request, file reference identifier, requester identity.
Output: Retry eligibility indicator set to not allowed, authorization failure notification, audit trail entry.
Description: The system prevents unsafe retries when the requester identity cannot be validated after rollback occurs.
FR-81 Uploaded File Storage Failure Rollback
Input: Uploaded file, upload request, file reference identifier, report request.
Output: Upload failure rejection, file reference invalidation, dependent artifact creation cancellation, audit trail entry.
Description: The system ensures file upload failures do not create incomplete or misleading dependent artifacts.
FR-82 Failure Notification for File Storage Operations
Input: File storage failure, requester ID, export request, import request.
Output: Email notification outcome, failure reason communication outcome.
Description: The system informs requesters when file storage operations fail for import or export requests.
FR-83 Failure Notification When Export Data Persistence Fails
Input: SQL database interface failure, requester ID, export request.
Output: Email notification outcome, failure reason communication outcome.
Description: The system notifies requesters when export generation fails because persisted data cannot be accessed.
FR-84 Failure Notification When Import Asset Persistence Fails
Input: SQL database interface failure, requester ID, import request, uploaded file.
Output: Email notification outcome, failure reason communication outcome.
Description: The system informs requesters when an import cannot be completed because imported asset records cannot be persisted.
FR-85 Authentication System Integration
Input: User identity claim, authentication request, external authentication response data.
Output: Verified or normalized user identity data, authentication outcome.
Description: The system integrates with a centralized authentication system to verify user identities and support access control.
FR-86 Authentication Outage Fallback for Protected Actions
Input: Action request, user identity claim, requested operation.
Output: Action denial, standardized error response, access decision log entry.
Description: The system maintains secure access control behavior when centralized authentication is unavailable.
FR-87 Email Notification System
Input: Notification event, recipient identity, notification payload.
Output: Notification delivery status.
Description: The system sends automated emails for approval requests, asset alerts, and system notifications.
FR-88 Database Interface
Input: Asset data, user information, logs, audit trails.
Output: Persisted records and retrieval results.
Description: The system stores all asset data, user information, logs, and audit trails through a SQL database interface.
FR-89 File Storage Interface
Input: Uploaded file, generated report, file reference identifier.
Output: Stored file reference or storage failure outcome.
Description: The system stores uploaded files and generated report artifacts in local or cloud file storage.
FR-90 Action Audit Logging
Input: Action type, actor identifier, target entity identifier, timestamp.
Output: Audit log entry.
Description: The system records traceable audit entries for approval decisions, permission changes, transfers, returns, and asset state changes.
FR-91 Audit Logging Outcome When Data Layer Fails
Input: Event type, event identifiers, requester user ID.
Output: Audit trail entry creation failed, audit trail failure indicator, system notification.
Description: The system records and surfaces audit logging failures so traceability gaps caused by unavailable persistence are visible to authorized stakeholders.

# Functional Requirements Summary
This document provides a consolidated set of functional requirements for the Transportation Management System. It merges the useful requirements from the three source documents, removes duplicates and weak or invalid items, and rewrites the numbering in a clean sequential order.
---
## 1. Vehicle Management and Registration
### FR-01 Vehicle Registration
**Input:** Make, model, license plate, VIN, registration status.
**Output:** Updated Data Cache and Data Archive; refreshed Map Display and Icon Layer.
**Description:** Administrators can register, update, or remove vehicle records. The system validates required fields, checks for duplicate VIN or license plate values, and synchronizes the resulting vehicle state across storage and visualization layers.
### FR-02 Manage Vehicle Data
**Input:** VIN, license plate, location, speed, vehicle status, action type.
**Output:** Updated vehicle data in the Data Cache and Data Archive; refreshed Map Display and Icon Layer.
**Description:** The system supports adding, updating, and removing real-time vehicle data, including location, speed, and operational status.
### FR-03 Read Vehicle Information
**Input:** VIN or license plate.
**Output:** Vehicle details, current status, and location displayed in the user interface and on the map.
**Description:** The system retrieves vehicle information using VIN or license plate and presents the same authoritative record in both the details view and map representation.
### FR-04 Delete Vehicle Record
**Input:** VIN or license plate.
**Output:** Vehicle record removed or marked inactive; vehicle icon removed from Map Display and Icon Layer.
**Description:** Administrators can delete or deregister a vehicle. The system ensures the vehicle no longer appears in active views, queries, map layers, or icon displays.
### FR-05 Vehicle Record Existence Validation
**Input:** Vehicle identifier, requested operation.
**Output:** Validation success, not-found response, or duplicate-conflict response.
**Description:** The system verifies that a vehicle record exists before read, update, or delete operations, and verifies that a duplicate record does not already exist before registration.
### FR-06 Vehicle Registration Resolution
**Input:** Vehicle registration identifier, VIN, license plate.
**Output:** Resolved authoritative vehicle record or structured resolution error.
**Description:** The system resolves registration records to authoritative vehicle records before downstream use in reporting, visualization, incident context, and traveler context.
### FR-07 Vehicle Data Failure Recovery
**Input:** Vehicle add, update, delete, or registration operation; failure condition.
**Output:** Rollback outcome, restored previous state, failure notification, audit entry.
**Description:** If a vehicle management operation fails during processing, the system rolls back partial writes and restores the last known consistent state.
### FR-08 Vehicle Cache Synchronization
**Input:** Vehicle record update, deletion, registration status change.
**Output:** Updated Vehicle Data Cache and synchronized Map/Icon Layer state.
**Description:** Updates to vehicle records must atomically update the vehicle cache so that the Icon Layer and Map Display reflect the current vehicle state.
### FR-09 Vehicle Archive Consistency
**Input:** Vehicle data update, archival write request, time range.
**Output:** Consistent archived vehicle data or archive failure notification.
**Description:** The system queues or performs archival writes for vehicle data changes and ensures archived datasets are temporally consistent for requested time ranges.
### FR-10 Multi-Source Vehicle Retrieval
**Input:** Vehicle identifier, requested time range.
**Output:** Vehicle data retrieved from Data Cache or Data Archive.
**Description:** The system selects the appropriate data source for vehicle retrieval, using the Data Cache for current data and the Data Archive for historical data.
### FR-11 Exclude Deleted Vehicle Data
**Input:** Vehicle query, active-view request, soft-deleted vehicle record.
**Output:** Query result excluding deleted records.
**Description:** Soft-deleted or deregistered vehicle records must not appear in active details views, map views, traffic context, or traveler-facing outputs.
### FR-12 Vehicle Archive Update Failure Notification
**Input:** Vehicle operation, archive update failure, vehicle identifier, error code, timestamp.
**Output:** Administrator notification and fallback log entry.
**Description:** When a vehicle archive update fails, the system notifies administrators with the affected vehicle, operation type, error details, and timestamp.
---
## 2. Traffic Data Collection and Analysis
### FR-13 Traffic Data Collection
**Input:** External traffic data, including speed, volume, occupancy, location, and time.
**Output:** Validated traffic data stored in Data Cache and Data Archive; Map Display updated.
**Description:** The system collects real-time traffic data from registered external sources and stores validated records for analysis and visualization.
### FR-14 Registered Source Requirement for Ingestion
**Input:** External data source identifier, incoming traffic data.
**Output:** Accepted ingestion or rejected request with log entry.
**Description:** The system accepts data only from registered external sources. Data from unregistered sources is rejected at the boundary and logged.
### FR-15 Traffic Data Collection Failure Handling
**Input:** Traffic data collection failure, last valid traffic dataset.
**Output:** Degraded traffic status, stale-data indicator, operator alert.
**Description:** If traffic data collection fails, the system retains the most recent valid data, marks it as degraded or stale, and keeps visual indicators visible with appropriate warnings.
### FR-16 Analyze Traffic Metrics
**Input:** Traffic data, analysis parameters, geographic area, time frame.
**Output:** Congestion levels, travel times, queue lengths, and derived traffic metrics.
**Description:** The system analyzes collected traffic data using configured algorithms to derive traffic performance metrics.
### FR-17 Metrics Analysis Fallback
**Input:** Traffic analysis request, invalid output format, invalid time frame, or analysis failure.
**Output:** Last-known-good result, fallback time frame, or structured failure response.
**Description:** If traffic metrics analysis cannot complete normally, the system uses a defined fallback such as the last complete interval or a known-good format.
### FR-18 Pre-Metric Data Validation
**Input:** Traffic data, data quality rules.
**Output:** Validated traffic dataset or rejected dataset with reason.
**Description:** Traffic data must pass quality checks before being used to derive metrics, congestion levels, alerts, or external publications.
### FR-19 Update Traffic Status
**Input:** Latest validated traffic data, geographic area, road segment identifier.
**Output:** Updated traffic status, refreshed Map Display and Icon Layer.
**Description:** The system updates traffic status for defined geographic areas and road segments based on the latest validated data.
### FR-20 Preserve Last Known Valid Traffic Status
**Input:** Traffic status update, validation failure, write failure.
**Output:** Restored previous valid state, rollback log, operator alert.
**Description:** If a traffic status update fails before commitment, the system aborts the transaction and restores the previous valid traffic state.
### FR-21 Traffic Metrics to Congestion Conversion
**Input:** Traffic metrics, road segment identifier, congestion algorithm.
**Output:** Traffic congestion level for the segment.
**Description:** The system converts raw traffic metrics into standardized congestion levels for specific road segments.
### FR-22 Segment Binding for Traffic Status
**Input:** Traffic status data, road segment identifier.
**Output:** Segment-bound traffic status and visualization.
**Description:** Traffic status and congestion visualizations must be bound to a resolved road segment identifier.
### FR-23 View Traffic Congestion
**Input:** Geographic area, traffic metrics, map layer settings.
**Output:** Congestion visualization showing speed, density, or congestion level.
**Description:** The system visualizes traffic congestion using spatial data aligned to the Michigan Geographic Framework.
### FR-24 Browse Traffic Information
**Input:** Geographic area, time range, traffic data type.
**Output:** Real-time or historical traffic information displayed on the map.
**Description:** Administrators can browse traffic information using current or archived traffic datasets.
### FR-25 Traffic Browse Synchronization
**Input:** Traffic browsing result, active congestion visualization dataset.
**Output:** Synchronized browsing and visualization state.
**Description:** Traffic browsing results must remain synchronized with the active congestion visualization dataset.
### FR-26 Traffic Analysis Time Range Validation
**Input:** Analysis start time, end time, maximum duration rule, predictive flag.
**Output:** Accepted analysis request or validation error.
**Description:** The system validates traffic analysis time ranges to ensure start time precedes end time, duration limits are respected, and future dates are allowed only for predictive analysis.
### FR-27 Integrated Traffic Fallback
**Input:** Missing weather data, missing road condition data, traffic analysis request.
**Output:** Degraded-mode traffic status or most recent valid cached result.
**Description:** If integrated weather or road condition data is unavailable, traffic analysis proceeds in degraded mode with appropriate indicators.
---
## 3. Weather and Road Condition Monitoring
### FR-28 Weather Data Integration
**Input:** Temperature, precipitation, visibility, time, geographic area.
**Output:** Integrated weather data for traffic, road condition, and incident processing.
**Description:** The system integrates real-time weather data to support traffic analysis, road surface inference, and incident detection.
### FR-29 Process Weather Observations
**Input:** Raw weather observations.
**Output:** Normalized weather records.
**Description:** The system processes raw weather observations into structured records suitable for analysis, visualization, and downstream inference.
### FR-30 Persist Weather Observations
**Input:** Processed weather observations, time range, geographic area.
**Output:** Persisted weather records.
**Description:** Processed weather observations are persisted by time range and geographic area. Reprocessing the same period must be idempotent and must not create duplicate records.
### FR-31 Modify Weather Record
**Input:** Weather record identifier, updated weather observation, administrator identity.
**Output:** Updated weather record or validation rejection.
**Description:** Authorized administrators can modify weather records after validation.
### FR-32 Weather Modification Authorization
**Input:** Administrator identity, weather modification request.
**Output:** Authorized update or denied operation.
**Description:** Weather record modifications are restricted to authorized administrators.
### FR-33 Weather Modification Validation
**Input:** Weather modification request, validation rules.
**Output:** Validated weather record or rejection reason.
**Description:** Weather record changes must be validated before being used in road surface inference or map visualization.
### FR-34 Weather Modification Propagation
**Input:** Modified weather record, affected geographic area.
**Output:** Recomputed road condition and surface status outputs.
**Description:** Modified weather records must trigger recomputation of dependent road condition and inferred surface status pipelines.
### FR-35 Road Condition Monitoring
**Input:** Road segment, surface condition, visibility, friction, weather signal.
**Output:** Road condition visualization and stored road condition record.
**Description:** The system monitors road surface conditions and displays condition states on the Map Display.
### FR-36 Infer Road Surface Status
**Input:** Processed weather data, traffic data, road condition data, geo-referenced segment.
**Output:** Inferred road surface status, such as icy, wet, or dry.
**Description:** The system infers road surface status by combining weather, traffic, and road condition data.
### FR-37 Road Surface Inference Failure Recovery
**Input:** Surface inference process, failure condition, last valid surface state.
**Output:** Rolled-back surface status, failure log, operator notification.
**Description:** If inference fails mid-execution, the system rolls back to the last valid road surface state and logs the failure.
### FR-38 Publish Inferred Road Status
**Input:** Inferred road surface status, road segment identifier.
**Output:** Stored Road Condition Record and refreshed visualization.
**Description:** Inferred road surface status must be persisted and immediately reflected in the road condition map layer.
### FR-39 Road Condition Authoritative Source
**Input:** Road condition visualization request.
**Output:** Visualization based on stored Road Condition Record.
**Description:** Road condition visualizations must use committed Road Condition Records rather than uncommitted cached values.
### FR-40 Road Condition Data Unavailability Handling
**Input:** Traffic status update, missing road condition data.
**Output:** Degraded-mode processing indicator and continued traffic update.
**Description:** If road condition data is unavailable, traffic status updates may proceed in degraded mode with a visible indicator.
### FR-41 Update Road Condition
**Input:** Road segment identifier, closure status, visibility, surface condition, administrator identity.
**Output:** Updated road condition record and refreshed map.
**Description:** Authorized administrators can update road condition status for road segments, including closures and visibility impacts.
---
## 4. Incident Management
### FR-42 Incident Detection
**Input:** Traffic data, road condition data, weather data, inferred surface status.
**Output:** Detected incident record or empty-incident response.
**Description:** The system detects incidents such as accidents, breakdowns, closures, or abnormal traffic conditions using validated inputs.
### FR-43 Incident Detection Prerequisites
**Input:** Incident detection request, inferred road surface status, required input signals.
**Output:** Detection execution or blocked request with reason.
**Description:** Incident detection must not execute unless required inputs, including current inferred road surface status when applicable, are available and valid.
### FR-44 Incident Detection Fallback
**Input:** Traffic data collection failure, last valid traffic data, staleness threshold.
**Output:** Incident detection using last valid data or defined empty response.
**Description:** If traffic data collection fails, incident detection uses last valid data within an allowed staleness window or returns a defined empty result.
### FR-45 Incident Lifecycle Integration
**Input:** Detected incident, existing incident record, incident status.
**Output:** Created or updated managed incident record.
**Description:** Incident detection must create or update managed incident records with lifecycle status and must prevent duplicates for the same incident.
### FR-46 Manage Incident Details
**Input:** Incident identifier, location, type, severity, time, status, administrator action.
**Output:** Created, updated, or removed incident details.
**Description:** Administrators can manage incident details, including type, severity, location, time, and status.
### FR-47 Incident Detail Persistence
**Input:** Incident detail update, history store.
**Output:** Updated current incident record and synchronized incident history.
**Description:** Changes to incident details must propagate to the incident history store immediately.
### FR-48 Delete Incident Record
**Input:** Incident identifier.
**Output:** Removed incident record and removed map representation.
**Description:** Administrators can delete incident records and remove corresponding incident visuals.
### FR-49 Incident Deletion Rollback
**Input:** Incident deletion request, deletion failure.
**Output:** Restored incident and history state.
**Description:** Deleting an incident and related history must be atomic. If deletion fails, the system restores the pre-deletion state.
### FR-50 View Incident Information
**Input:** Incident identifier.
**Output:** Incident location, type, severity, time, status, and related details.
**Description:** The system retrieves detailed incident information for display in the user interface.
### FR-51 View Incident History
**Input:** Time range, geographic area, incident type, incident identifier.
**Output:** Historical incident records.
**Description:** The system retrieves historical incident records by area, time range, type, or incident identifier.
### FR-52 Link Incident Details to History
**Input:** Incident identifier.
**Output:** Coordinated response containing current incident details and related history.
**Description:** When viewing an incident, the system retrieves both current details and historical records using the same identifier.
### FR-53 Incident Identifier Validation
**Input:** Incident identifier, incident view request.
**Output:** Incident details or structured validation failure.
**Description:** Incident detail views are produced only for valid and resolvable incident identifiers.
### FR-54 Incident Spatial Consistency
**Input:** Incident map view request, stored incident record.
**Output:** Spatial view consistent with authoritative incident data.
**Description:** Incident map views must use authoritative stored records to ensure consistency between the database and the map.
### FR-55 Incident History Cache Sourcing
**Input:** Incident history request, cache validity indicator.
**Output:** Incident history from cache or archive.
**Description:** Incident history retrieval may use a valid Incident Data Cache for performance while preserving correctness.
---
## 5. Data Cache, Archive, and Data Governance
### FR-56 Data Caching Management
**Input:** Data type, caching policy, synchronization request.
**Output:** Optimized Data Cache and synchronized archive state.
**Description:** The system manages caching strategies to support fast map, UI, and processing operations.
### FR-57 Archive Historical Data
**Input:** Data type, time range, archival policy.
**Output:** Archived historical dataset and archive identifier.
**Description:** The system moves historical data from cache to long-term archive storage based on configured time ranges.
### FR-58 Retrieve Archived Data
**Input:** Archive identifier, data type, time range.
**Output:** Retrieved historical dataset and validity status.
**Description:** The system retrieves archived data for analysis, visualization, or review and surfaces data validity to the user.
### FR-59 Archived Identifier Generation
**Input:** Archival operation, data type, time range.
**Output:** Archive identifier encoding data type and time range.
**Description:** Archiving operations produce identifiers that support future retrieval, validation, and traceability.
### FR-60 Cache Consistency Validation
**Input:** Cache version, latest write timestamp, registration status.
**Output:** Cache-valid response or forced refresh.
**Description:** Cache versions must be checked against latest write timestamps and registration status before serving data.
### FR-61 Data Quality Validation
**Input:** Incoming data, validation rules, declared data type.
**Output:** Accepted data, corrected data, invalid-data flag, or rejection.
**Description:** The system validates incoming data for consistency, completeness, accuracy, and schema suitability.
### FR-62 Modify Data Quality Rule
**Input:** Data rule identifier, threshold, tolerance, rule scope.
**Output:** Updated validation rule.
**Description:** Authorized administrators can modify data validation thresholds, tolerances, and rule definitions.
### FR-63 Manage Data Rule
**Input:** Data rule definition, data type, time range, scope, action.
**Output:** Created, updated, deleted, or retrieved rule.
**Description:** The system manages data rules used for validation and downstream processing.
### FR-64 Data Rule Scope Enforcement
**Input:** Dataset, data rule identifier, data type, time range.
**Output:** Rule execution outcome and downstream eligibility result.
**Description:** Data must be evaluated against applicable rules before being passed to downstream consumers such as analysis, alerts, or publication.
### FR-65 Data Rule Applicability Constraints
**Input:** Data type, time range, available rules.
**Output:** Applicable rule set or alert when no rules apply.
**Description:** Only rules valid for the specified data type and time range are executed. If no applicable rule exists, the system generates an alert.
### FR-66 Rule Attribution
**Input:** Validated dataset, data rule identifier.
**Output:** Dataset tagged with governing Data Rule ID.
**Description:** Validated datasets must be tagged with the specific rule that governed acceptance or rejection.
### FR-67 Data Quality Rule Execution Audit
**Input:** Data rule execution, dataset identifier, outcome, timestamp.
**Output:** Persisted rule execution audit record.
**Description:** The system persists records of data quality rule executions for traceability.
### FR-68 Validation Failure Notification
**Input:** Validation failure, downstream blocked outcome, failure reason.
**Output:** Administrator or stakeholder notification.
**Description:** The system notifies stakeholders when validation failures prevent downstream processing or publication.
---
## 6. Administration, Access Control, and Authorization
### FR-69 Administrator Login
**Input:** Administrator credentials.
**Output:** Login success or failure, active session record.
**Description:** The system validates administrator credentials and creates a session record after successful login.
### FR-70 Login Failure Notification
**Input:** Failed login attempt, account status, failure reason.
**Output:** Login failure message and stakeholder notification when required.
**Description:** The system notifies authorized stakeholders of failed or blocked administrator login attempts, including escalation for repeated failures.
### FR-71 Access User Interface
**Input:** Login confirmation, active session.
**Output:** Granted or rejected user interface access.
**Description:** Access to protected administrative user interface functions is granted only after successful login confirmation.
### FR-72 Session Validity Enforcement
**Input:** Session token, protected operation request.
**Output:** Operation allowed or rejected.
**Description:** Sensitive operations require a valid, non-expired session token, rechecked at each action boundary.
### FR-73 Operation-Level Authorization
**Input:** User identity, session, requested operation, resource identifier.
**Output:** Authorized operation or denied operation.
**Description:** Authorization is checked for each privileged action, including create, update, delete, configure, publish, and remove operations.
### FR-74 Resource-Scoped Authorization
**Input:** User identity, policy, vehicle ID, traffic ID, asset ID, or map layer ID.
**Output:** Resource-specific authorization decision.

# Functional Requirements Summary: Vehicle Infrastructure Integration Data Use Analysis and Processing System
This document provides a consolidated set of functional requirements for the Vehicle Infrastructure Integration Data Use Analysis and Processing system. It merges the useful requirements from the three source documents, removes duplicate or weak requirements, and rewrites the numbering in a clean sequential order.
---
## 1. Core System Data Collection and Processing
### FR-01 VII DUAP Data Collection
**Input:** Probe vehicle data, traffic management system data, weather station data, traveler information system data.
**Output:** Traffic metrics, incident records, road surface assessments, alerts, quality-checked datasets.
**Description:** The system collects real-time data from probe vehicles, traffic management systems, weather stations, and traveler information systems for downstream processing and analysis.
### FR-02 Probe Vehicle Data Processing
**Input:** Vehicle speed, location, heading, direction, brake usage, timestamp.
**Output:** Processed probe vehicle records and derived traffic or road condition inputs.
**Description:** The system processes probe vehicle data for use in traffic metrics, road surface assessments, incident inference, and quality validation.
### FR-03 Traffic Management System Data Processing
**Input:** Signal status, incident reports, road status, infrastructure status, timestamp.
**Output:** Processed traffic management data and alert-ready event inputs.
**Description:** The system ingests and processes data from traffic management systems to support incident inference, traffic status monitoring, and alert generation.
### FR-04 Weather Station Data Processing
**Input:** Temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind speed, visibility, station identifier, timestamp.
**Output:** Processed weather observations and weather-derived inputs for analysis.
**Description:** The system processes real-time weather station observations for traffic analysis, road surface assessment, alerting, and visualization.
### FR-05 Traveler Information Data Processing
**Input:** Traveler advisories, route information, presentation data, external traveler information system records.
**Output:** Traveler-facing information inputs and formatted advisory data.
**Description:** The system ingests traveler information data to support advisories, MI Drive presentation, and dissemination workflows.
### FR-06 Real-Time Traffic Data Storage
**Input:** Validated real-time traffic data, probe vehicle data, traffic management data.
**Output:** Stored traffic data in Oracle 10G database.
**Description:** The system stores real-time traffic data in the Oracle 10G database for analysis, retrieval, visualization, and archival processing.
### FR-07 Data Synchronization Across Sources
**Input:** Traffic data, weather observations, road condition data, timestamps.
**Output:** Synchronized multi-source dataset and synchronization status.
**Description:** The system synchronizes traffic, weather, and road condition data to ensure temporal consistency before analysis, alerting, or visualization.
### FR-08 Infrastructure Data Validation Before Processing
**Input:** Infrastructure update, signal status, road status, signage status, data quality rules.
**Output:** Accepted infrastructure input or rejected input with validation reason.
**Description:** Infrastructure updates must be validated against data quality rules before entering the processing pipeline.
### FR-09 Multi-Source Processing Output Generation
**Input:** Validated traffic, weather, infrastructure, probe vehicle, and traveler information data.
**Output:** Traffic metrics, incident inferences, road surface assessments, quality indicators, alerts.
**Description:** The system integrates validated vehicle and infrastructure data into processed outputs for downstream analytics and presentation.

# Functional Requirements Summary: Vehicle Infrastructure Integration Data Use Analysis and Processing System
This document provides a consolidated set of functional requirements for the Vehicle Infrastructure Integration Data Use Analysis and Processing system. It merges the useful requirements from the three source documents, removes duplicate or weak requirements, and rewrites the numbering in a clean sequential order.
---
## 1. Core Data Processing and Collection
### FR-01 Data Processing and Analysis
**Input:** Real-time data streams from Probe Vehicles, Traffic Management Systems, Weather Stations, Traveler Information Systems, and Road Sensors.
**Output:** Updated Traffic Metrics, Incident Details, Road Surface Conditions, Weather Observations, alerts, and visualization-ready data.
**Description:** The system processes and analyzes incoming Vehicle Infrastructure Integration data from multiple sources to generate actionable transportation insights.
### FR-02 Traffic Data Collection
**Input:** Vehicle location, speed, heading, travel time, timestamp, and source identifier.
**Output:** Validated Traffic Data stored in Oracle 10g and made available for analysis and dissemination.
**Description:** The system collects real-time traffic data from Probe Vehicles and other authorized data sources for validation, storage, analysis, and traveler information updates.
### FR-03 Probe Vehicle Data Processing
**Input:** Probe vehicle speed, location, heading, travel time, brake usage, and communication metadata.
**Output:** Processed probe vehicle records for traffic metrics, road surface calculation, and incident inference.
**Description:** The system processes Probe Vehicle data and makes it available to downstream functions such as traffic analysis, travel demand monitoring, and road condition assessment.
### FR-04 Traffic Management System Data Processing
